item.title: Bed Bugs & Mattress Encasements
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
By P. Bello
Since the first “On the Road With . . .” column writing has been an interesting pursuit accomplished by following a rather simple recipe; go on the road to work in the field, see something interesting and worth writing about and then publish a column. Inspirational subject matter and topicality are observed nearly every day. However, once in a while an editor, publisher or industry constituent comes through with requested topicality which is the case for this very article. Recently some e-mail conversations and announcements were forwarded to me. After reviewing these communications it appeared that some folks may have missed some key points on the role played by mattress encasements in a bed bug management program. With property managers informing their property owners that with the purchase and installation of mattress covers that their bed bug concerns were over, it was clear that some additional information about mattress encasements was warranted. Mattress Covers vs. Mattress Encasements. Mattress covers have been around a long time and, like most things, have evolved along the way. Mattress covers are not mattress encasements. Covers are intended to simply due as their name indicates, to cover the mattress. In doing so the low end and precursor units to today’s fancier models were simply intended to cover the mattress to prevent damage, stains and other such things from occurring to the mattress. For the most part, these covers simply cover the top. Currently available models may vary from a simple cover to plush padded pillow top type models that enhance the mattress. However, these covers are not bed bug proof encasements. They are merely covers. Mattress encasements actually encase the mattress. Units are also available to encase box springs as well. Encasements fully encase, wrap or envelop the mattress or box spring. Once installed they zip shut to fully enclose the mattress or box spring within leaving no portion of the mattress or box spring exposed. Bed Bug Tested &amp; Bed Bug Proof. There are any number of models and brand name mattress encasements commercially available today. However, those units that have been engineered for and independently tested to be bed bug proof are the best choice for you especially if your intention is to enhance your bed bug management program. Note that in the free market economy buyer beware is a recurrent theme we should consider. As such, check out that the encasement you purchase is in fact independently tested at a credible research lab to be bed bug proof. If so, the manufacturer will have a supporting data publication available for your review on their website or within their sales information documents. Don’t be fooled by low cost or cheap imitations.
What does bed bug tested and bed bug proof mean? Sometimes, possibly more often than not, marketing claims and product performance data may be slightly different from each other. The phrase your mileage may vary comes to mind. This said, we need to understand what the phrases and terms being used actually mean. By bed bug tested and bed bug proof we mean that the encasement tested has proven to be bite proof, escape proof and entry proof by bed bugs. That is to say that a bed bug within the encasement is not able to bite a person through the material nor is it able to escape from the encasement through the zipper mechanism. Further, bed bugs are not able to enter these units from the exterior either through the fabric or through the zipper mechanism. The role of encasements in bed bug management? We need to clearly understand what the role of mattress encasements are in a bed bug management program. Just because you have installed mattress and box spring encasements does not mean that your property will not get bed bugs. It is still possible that bed bugs can be brought in to your property by a traveling guest or otherwise however, once encasements have been installed the mattress and box spring are protected from bed bug intrusion and fecal staining. Take a quick look at a mattress and box spring. With pillow tops, decorative ticking and stitching mattresses offer bed bugs a multitude of hiding places where they may easily evade detection during a visual inspection. Perhaps even worse is the potential hiding places within a box spring. Once inside a box spring there are several locations where bed bugs may hide undetected by inspection while also evading subsequent bed bug control efforts. Suitably installed encasements prevent this. Additionally, because encasements are essentially a smooth surface, bed bug activity is more easily detected during subsequent inspections should bed bugs be introduced. All encasements are not created equal ! Again, it’s buyer beware! If you’re serious about bed bug management than you are not interested in poor quality and non-tested encasement units. Encasements come in varying qualities, features and benefits. The qualities of prime concern are durability and sleep comfort. After all, while it may be possible to successfully encase using 8 mill plastic sheeting, who wants to sleep on a sheet of plastic? Manufactures may offer a few models at different price points. In my experience, the higher end models offer greater comfortable and durability for use on a mattress. Of prime concern for a box spring encasement is durability and the ability to resist tears. Which encasements are recommended? There are a number of manufacturers who offer quality mattress encasements. The units I recommend are manufactured by Mattress Safe located in Cumming, GA. Mattress Safe encasements have been tested bed bug proof by independent labs and have the advantage of being engineered such that the sides are stretchable while remaining bed bug proof. This is a huge advantage because the mattress height does not need to be measured to purchase the correct fitting encasement size as may be the case with competing brands. Go to www.mattresssafe.com for further information.
For which ever units you elect to purchase be sure that it has been tested bed bug proof and offers good comfort and durability. While the installation of encasements may not totally protect your location from an inadvertent bed bug introduction, they will help you to protect the valuable investment in your bedding and enhance your inspection and early detection success. Encasements are an important recommended portion of your ongoing bed bug management program.

item.title: Wasp and Hornet Exterminator in Tulsa
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
When wasps or hornets build a nest on your home or business, the situation can quickly turn dangerous. These aggressive stinging insects defend their colonies fiercely, especially during late summer and early fall. If you’re searching for a reliable wasp and hornet exterminator in Tulsa, professional treatment is the safest and most effective solution.

In Tulsa, warm temperatures and long summers create the perfect environment for wasps and hornets to thrive. Understanding the risks and knowing when to call a professional can protect your family, pets, employees, and customers.

Why Wasps and Hornets Are a Serious Problem

Unlike bees, many species of wasps and hornets can sting multiple times. Their stings are painful and can cause severe allergic reactions in some individuals. Large nests near entryways, patios, sheds, playgrounds, or commercial properties increase the likelihood of encounters.

Common problems include:

  • Nests under eaves, soffits, and rooflines
  • Colonies inside wall voids or attics
  • Ground nests in lawns or landscaping
  • Increased aggression in late summer

Disturbing a nest without proper protection can trigger a swarm attack. DIY sprays often fail to eliminate the entire colony and can make the insects more aggressive.

Common Wasps and Hornets in Tulsa

Tulsa homeowners and businesses typically encounter:

Paper Wasps

These slender wasps build umbrella-shaped nests under eaves and porch ceilings. They are territorial and will sting if threatened.

Yellowjackets

Highly aggressive and attracted to food, yellowjackets often build nests underground or inside wall voids. They are responsible for many sting incidents in Oklahoma.

Bald-Faced Hornets

Technically a type of yellowjacket, these hornets build large, enclosed aerial nests in trees and on structures. Their colonies can contain hundreds of insects.

Each species requires a different treatment approach. A professional exterminator can properly identify the species and apply targeted control methods.

Why DIY Wasp Removal Is Risky

Many store-bought wasp sprays only kill visible insects and fail to eliminate the queen. Without removing or neutralizing the entire colony, the problem can return quickly.

DIY risks include:

  • Multiple stings
  • Severe allergic reactions
  • Falling from ladders while spraying high nests
  • Incomplete elimination

Professional wasp and hornet control ensures the nest is treated safely and effectively, minimizing risk and preventing reinfestation.

Professional Wasp & Hornet Extermination Process

A professional Tulsa exterminator typically follows a thorough process:

1. Inspection

The technician identifies nest location, species, and activity level.

2. Targeted Treatment

Specialized products and equipment are used to eliminate the colony safely.

3. Nest Removal (When Necessary)

Removing the nest reduces attraction for other wasps and improves safety.

4. Prevention Recommendations

Sealing entry points, reducing attractants, and addressing conducive conditions help prevent future nesting.

Residential and Commercial Wasp Control in Tulsa

Wasps and hornets can threaten:

  • Homes
  • Apartment complexes
  • Restaurants
  • Warehouses
  • Schools
  • Office buildings

For businesses, visible nests can be a liability and create safety concerns for customers and staff. Fast, professional treatment protects your reputation and reduces risk.

When to Call a Wasp and Hornet Exterminator

Contact a professional if you notice:

  • Increased wasp activity around your home
  • Visible nests under rooflines or in trees
  • Ground holes with frequent insect traffic
  • Aggressive swarming behavior

Early intervention prevents colonies from growing larger and more dangerous.

Protect Your Tulsa Property Today

If you’re dealing with a wasp or hornet problem, don’t take unnecessary risks. A licensed wasp and hornet exterminator in Tulsa can safely eliminate the nest and restore peace of mind.

Professional pest control provides:

  • Fast response
  • Safe, effective treatments
  • Long-lasting protection
  • Expert identification and prevention strategies

Don’t wait until someone gets stung. Schedule a professional inspection and keep your property in Tulsa protected from dangerous stinging insects year-round.

item.title: Common Spiders in Oklahoma
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Spiders are a normal part of the ecosystem in Oklahoma. While most species are harmless and even beneficial, some can pose health risks if disturbed. Understanding common spiders in Oklahoma helps homeowners identify potential concerns and know when professional pest control may be necessary.

The warm climate and seasonal humidity across Oklahoma create ideal conditions for many spider species to thrive indoors and outdoors.

Why Spiders Enter Homes

Spiders typically move indoors for three main reasons:

  • Searching for food (other insects)
  • Escaping extreme heat or cold
  • Seeking shelter to lay eggs

If you’re seeing frequent spider activity, it often signals a larger insect problem. Eliminating their food source is one of the most effective long-term control strategies.

Most Common Spiders in Oklahoma

Brown Recluse Spider

The Brown Recluse is one of the most well-known spiders in Oklahoma. It is light to dark brown and often identified by a violin-shaped marking on its back.

Key facts:

  • Prefers dark, undisturbed areas (closets, attics, storage boxes)
  • Shy and not aggressive
  • Bites can cause skin necrosis in some cases

Although bites are rare, medical attention is recommended if one is suspected.

Black Widow Spider

The Black Widow is another medically significant spider found in Oklahoma. Females are shiny black with a distinctive red hourglass marking on the underside of their abdomen.

Key facts:

  • Common around garages, sheds, and woodpiles
  • Webs are irregular and messy
  • Venom affects the nervous system

Black widow bites are rarely fatal but can be painful and require medical evaluation.

Wolf Spider

Wolf spiders are large, hairy spiders often mistaken for tarantulas. They do not spin webs to catch prey but instead hunt insects actively.

Key facts:

  • Frequently found in basements and garages
  • Fast-moving but not aggressive
  • Bites are uncommon and typically mild

Their size can be alarming, but they help control other pest populations.

House Spider

Common house spiders are small, brown spiders that build webs in corners and ceilings.

Key facts:

  • Harmless to humans
  • Create cobwebs in undisturbed areas
  • Feed on flies and small insects

Regular cleaning usually keeps them under control.

Jumping Spider

Jumping spiders are small, compact spiders known for their quick movements and excellent vision.

Key facts:

  • Often seen on walls or window sills
  • Curious but not dangerous
  • Rarely bite

They are considered beneficial because they prey on flies and other pests.

Are Oklahoma Spiders Dangerous?

Most spiders in Oklahoma are harmless and actually beneficial. Only the brown recluse and black widow are considered medically significant. However, even these spiders typically bite only when threatened or accidentally pressed against the skin.

Preventative steps include:

  • Reducing clutter
  • Sealing cracks and gaps
  • Installing tight-fitting door sweeps
  • Managing other insect populations
  • Keeping firewood stored away from structures

When to Call a Professional

You should consider professional pest control if:

  • You see multiple brown recluse or black widow spiders
  • Spider activity seems excessive
  • You suspect an infestation inside wall voids or attics
  • You’re unsure about species identification

A licensed pest control professional can inspect your home, identify species accurately, and implement targeted treatment if necessary.

Keeping Your Oklahoma Home Spider-Free

Spiders are part of the natural environment in Oklahoma, but they don’t have to share your living space. Routine pest control, proper home maintenance, and reducing insect activity go a long way toward preventing spider problems.

If you’re dealing with recurring spider issues, professional service can provide peace of mind and long-term protection for your home or business.

item.title: What is an Exterminator? 5 Types, Duties & When To Hire
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
In this article today, you are going to learn all about exterminator and what job is actually done by exterminators in our local areas. You will see different types based on the pest present in your home. We have also explained when you need to hire an exterminator for your pest control project.

What is an Exterminator?

An exterminator is a professional pest control person which works to identify, manage, and eradicate the pest and infestation from target areas. Exterminators eliminate all types of insects such as ants, mosquitoes, rodents, cockroaches, termites, and bed bugs from residential, commercial, and industrial properties.

Exterminators have knowledge and trained tools used for handling pests in your home or property. They apply many techniques and follow different strategies to control infestation. They do their work very efficiently and ensure your house completely safe from pests.

5 Types of Exterminators

Exterminators have specialization in controlling different types of pests and infestations. Every specialised exterminator employs those methods to the pest which suitable for it. Some common exterminators are following: 

  1. Bed Bug Exterminators

Bed Bug exterminators specialise in recognizing and eradicating bed bugs. They apply particular chemicals and use different treatments like heat, and steam treatment. They eliminate bed bugs absolutely from your house and business. 

  1. Termite Exterminators

           Termite exterminators have a main focus on termite infestations. They identify their location and detect their severity. Then, for saving you and your family,  they use processes like baiting, fumigation.

  1. Insect Exterminators

If you want to detect and eliminate insects such as mosquitoes, fleas, ants, and cockroaches, then you should call an insect exterminator. Exterminators use certain chemicals and strategies to eradicate them from your house and property. 

See Also: Gopher Removal Tulsa OK | Pathfinder Pest Control

  1. Rodent Exterminators

Infestation of rodents handled by specialised rodent exterminators. They employ particular methods like trapping,and baiting to remove rodents from your property. Rodent exterminators also give advice to keep your place clean so that rodents do not enter your house.

  1. Wildlife Exterminators

Wildlife exterminators use humane trapping, and relocation processes to eliminate wildlife from houses and buildings. In wildlife, squirrels, raccoons, skunks, and birds are included. Wildlife exterminators protect your place from these wildlife completely.

Duties of an Exterminator

Exterminators perform different functions to eliminate the pests and infestations. They do their duties very efficiently and effectively. Main responsibilities of exterminators are following:

  1. Checking Properties

Exterminators inspect residential, commercial, and industrial areas to identify the pests and extent of infestations. Then they apply their specific methods to eradicate pests from these areas.

  1. Identifying Pests

For identifying the types of pests which cause the infestations, exterminators use their knowledge and experience. These pests may be insects, rodents, termite, bed bugs, and other wildlife. 

  1. Making Treatment Plans

In treatments, chemical pesticides, baits, traps, exclusion measures, and integrated pest management (IPM) are included. On the basis of your needs and types of pests, they use these methods.

  1. Apply Pest Control Measures

According to the treatment plans, handling, and eradicating pests from your house exterminators use pest control measures. Exterminators implement particular techniques like trapping, applying pesticides, and sealing all holes to inhibit pests.

  1. Give Awareness to Clients

It is also the duty of exterminator to educate the property owners about the type of pests, options to eliminate them, and precautions which will be helpful for the client. Exterminators tell preventive measures which protect your house from risk of pests.

Characteristics of an Exterminator

There are the following points which give you information about the exterminators: how do they work efficiently? 

  • Have Knowledge and Training

Exterminators are trained people who have proper knowledge about the behaviour and biology of the pests. They identify and control the pest population which is very difficult for you. 

  • Expert in Professional Tools

Exterminators have access to high-quality tools and products which are not managed by common people. Exterminators know their use but these tools are not managed by you. 

  • Secure Safety

Exterminators protect you and your family from pests because some pests such as rodents and insects cause diseases. Exterminators use the chemicals properly to kill them. Because their misuse creates problems.

  • Long-Term Solutions

Exterminators not only eliminate the present pests from your house rather save your house from infestations in future. Exterminators implement those solutions which eradicate pests permanently.

  • Saves Time and Efforts

Dealing with pests is a time consuming process for you. But exterminators do this work efficiently and fastly. They identify and solve the problem quickly.

  • Provide Peace of Mind 

Knowing that your pests problem is solved by a professional, you feel relaxed. You know very well that exterminators do this work in good manners, so this thing gives you peace of mind.

When Should You Hire an Exterminator?

Hiring the exterminator will be a good option when following conditions occur with you.

          When Having an Ongoing Infestation

When you notice the pests in your house continuously and not handled by you, then call the exterminator. Don’t leave the pests freely because they can be harmful for you and your family.

When Dealing With Dangerous Pests

If you are dealing with some dangerous pests such as wasps, rodents, and certain species of ants, then call the exterminator because handling these pests by yourself will not be safe.

When Not Identifying The Pest

When you see the signs of pests in your house but you are unaware about the pests then an exterminator will be helpful for you. Because pests identification is necessary before treatment.

When Worried About Property Damage

Some pests like carpenter ants, rodents, and termite cause structural damage. So when these pests damage your property then call the exterminator to eliminate them.  

When No Pesticides Handling

When you are not comfortable using the chemicals or pesticides to eradicate pests then it is better for you to take the help of an exterminator. They will do this task efficiently and safely.      

Conclusion

An exterminator is a professional pest control guy who has proper knowledge and training to handle the pests and infestations. They eliminate the reason of the problem from the roots. While DIY pest control methods work temporarily. So, if you face the pest problem, then we suggest you call the exterminator. It will be the best option for you and your family.

Do you live in Tulsa, Oklahoma and you are facing the problem of pests in your home? We suggest you contact us. Our expert team will be happy to help you. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Professional pest extermination usually lasts between 1 to 3 months for maintenance and repairing required. If infestation is severe then it takes 2-3 months. While sprays last for 90 days.

The charge of an exterminator usually ranges from $100 to $550 for standard residential fumigation. Their cost is based on the type of pests, size of property, and severity of infestations.

item.title: How Often Do You Need Pest Control At Your Home?
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Pests can come into your home suddenly. That means no one calls them, but they enter our properties for getting food, water and shelter. These pests include cockroaches, ants, spiders, bedbugs, termites and mice etc. So, you should try to remove pests from your home and protect your family. In today’s topic, we have explained how many times you need pest control service for your home. Let’s start reading.

Factors Affecting Pest Control Frequency

There are several factors which affect the pest control frequency.

  1. Location:

Surroundings and weather patterns influence the frequency of pests. Pests are found in any place or area where better food and water sources are available.

For example, rats are coming from nearby fields and cockroaches from factories.

  1. Kinds of Pest:

When you deal with pests, their type and life cycle is also kept in mind. The same treatment is not used for all types of pests. Pest control services use specific treatments for each type of pest.

  1. Severity of Infestation:

If you are not informed about pests and they have become a problem. You will need to manage them. Uncontrollable pests may take time to eliminate.

  1. Property Types:

The frequency of pest control is also based on the type of your property such as how old it is and whether it is located in a commercial or residential area.

  1. Past Treatment:

When you did your previous treatment, it also plays an important role. If you find pests in your surroundings then you need to control them. If you have not, then there is no issue.

These factors determine specific pest control requirements.

Symptoms Indicating The Need For Pest Control

Here are common signs that suggest it's time to consider pest control services.

Visible Pests:

When you notice pests it’s time to handle them and contact pest control services.

Related: Gopher Removal Tulsa OK | Pathfinder Pest Control

Property Destruction:

If your furniture is damaged or wires are chewed. It means pests are causing harm and need immediate attention.

Dropplings:

When you find excretes or feces it indicates the presence of pests in your home.

Odd Smells:

If you feel a strange or unusual smell. It could indicate the signs of pests.

Frequency of Pest Control For Various Pest Types

The following points show how many times pest control should be carried out for different pest categories.

  1. Monthly Pest Control:

Monthly services are necessary for areas which are dealing with high infestation and  recurring issues. For instance, these services are used to control pests such as cockroaches,ants and rodents.

  1. Quarterly Pest Control:

Quarterly services are suitable for overall protection and maintenance. For example, these services are used to control pests such as spiders.

  1.   Annually Pest Control:

Annually services are effective for minor problems but may not provide consistent protection throughout the year.

For example, these services are used to control pests such as termites and bedbugs which may require seasonal treatments.

Advantages of Regular Pest Control

Regular pest control offers several advantages that help maintain a clean, healthy and safe environment.

  • Pest Identification:

When you choose regular pest control services, your professionalists will identify the type of pest to tackle them and get rid of them using suitable pesticides.

  • Less Damage to Property:

If you select regular pest control services, you can control pests early and prevent property damage such as damage to a building’s internal structures.

  • Health Protection:

This service also promotes good health by preventing diseases and allergies caused by pests.

  • Cost Savings:

By controlling infestations and getting rid of pests, you can save a lot of money by preventing repair costs.

How Much Does Pest Control Cost?

The cost of pest control depends on multiple factors such as type of pest, severity of infestation and property size. Pest treatment is also based on contracts or packages which are offered by different companies.

One-time treatment ranges from $100 to $600. While quarterly visits cost between $100 and $300.

For more severe infestations like bedbugs and termites the cost can rise to $1000-$5500.

What are Preventive Measures to Control Pest?

To keep your environment pest-free after professional treatment make sure to follow the recommended guidelines.

  1. Seal all gaps, holes, cracks and leaking pipes to prevent pest entry.
  2. Reduce moisture, remove standing water and manage the drainage system.
  3. Store food safely after use and keep the kitchen clean because pests need food to survive.
  4. Keep your yard neat, trim vegetation and remove rotten leaves.
  5. Always follow the instructions provided by pest control professionals.

Final Thoughts

Keep up with regular pest control as it is essential to ensure safety, maintain hygiene, and protect your property. By understanding these elements you can implement an effective pest management strategy to keep your home pest-free. If you live in Tulsa and need pest control services, let’s talk to us now and get your free quote.

FAQs

Can I sleep in my house after pest control? 

Yes, you can sleep in your house after pest control but it depends on the type of treatment used. It’s best to wait for a few hours to allow chemicals to settle down.

What are the side effects of pest control?

Exposure to certain chemicals or pesticides can cause rashes, redness, coughing, sneezing and difficulty in breathing.

What should you not do after pest control?

Avoid immediate cleaning and mopping for at least 24-48 hours after pest control. Don’t use strong detergents and bleaches on treated surfaces because they can neutralize pesticides. Keep pets and children away from treated areas.

item.title: What is Pest Control? Examples, History, Methods & Benefits
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
If you are a homeowner, business owner or you generally want to know about pest control, today we will answer all your questions. This guide will explain everything you should know about pest control, types and what common pests you will see in your home. We have also discussed pest control services and when you need it in your property.

Pest Control Meaning

Pest control is the professional service in which unwanted animals known as pests including rodents, insects, bacteria, fungus, mites and other animals are managed or eliminated from the environment they inhabit such as homes, business offices, buildings or agriculture etc.

Pests can cause serious diseases by creating a mess at the place, contaminate the food and spreading the diseases, make it crucial to eradicate these uninvited creatures.

What is pest control at home?

Pest management at home include the control of pests production at living space to achieve a healthy and comfortable life full of hygiene. Everyone aspires to have a spotless home but unlikely if pests do manage to get inside the homes then it becomes frustrating for the inhabitants to live there then it becomes necessary to call a pest control professional to control pests growth.

At home you can follow following hygienic practices to keep pests away from your home:

  • Daily and deep cleaning
  • Dispose all the garbage or trash regularly
  • Check the roofs and basement
  • Store the food in air tight cans
  • Fill all the gaps and seat the cracks 

Pest Control Examples

A farmer notices light green colour with some stickiness on the leaves of his wheat crop, after identification he understood its reason, these were aphids in the field on wheat crops which were damaging the crop by releasing sticky material from them and making curls of its larvae on the leaves.

He will use a pesticide for them if aphids are at large scale or he will use ladybugs, natural predators of aphids, if the population of aphids is small. After pest control or all management he will get a high yield of crop with high quality.

Pest Control History

Since the beginning of time mankind had long battles with the pests, people used sulphur compounds to control insects and mites.Ancient china used botanical fungicides for seed treatments and oil sprays to control pests. With passing time people started documenting their pest control methods in the books and journals.

In 1880 first pest control spraying machine was made.Scientists distinguished all the beneficial insects from dangerous pests for agriculture and introduced artificial  lab sprays.Integraed Pest Management techniques, synthetic pesticides and genetically modified crops were introduced.In the most recent years many technologies are emerging to control pests and getting ready take the horizon. 

Common Pests in Homes / Types of Household Pests

A wide variety of pests are present in our homes and workspaces who require their own methods of management. Being aware of all these pests is necessary to clean all the surroundings whenever we encounter any of them.

  • Insects: Bedbugs, termites, cockroaches, ants, mosquitoes and house flies
  • Rodents: Mice and rats
  • Weeds: Unwanted plants and leaf minors
  • Birds: Seagulls, pigeons and swallows
  • Microorganisms: Bacteria, fungi and viruses

What Chemicals Do Pest Control Use?

Pests are present from little flies to a larger species and different types of chemicals are required to stop their uncontrolled population. Chemicals are present in many kinds such as in the form of sprays, dust and baits which targets metabolism or nervous system of pests.

All these chemicals play a vital role in managing pests wiping out. Choosing a best chemical according to the variety or species of pests is a task in itself. Some chemicals are following:

  • Pyrethroids / Pyrethrins is the most common and active substance used in controlling pests. Its most active ingredient is permethrin, commonly used for bedbugs, mosquitos, and cockroaches. These chemicals first paralyze the pest before killing.
  • Hydramethylnon is an effective metabolic inhibitor, inorganic compound, used for insects. It is a slow killer that takes mostly 3-4 days. 
  • Boric acid is a water soluble compound composed of boron, hydrogen and oxygen used for a variety of pests, termites, fungi, alga, spiders.
  • Organophosphatase is not commonly used due to its toxic effects.It has rapid biodegradability and has action of hours to days.
  • Neonicotinoids are commonly used in agriculture and affect the central nervous system of insects of crops.

04 Major Pest Control Methods

Pest control professionals have a variety of methods to deal with infestations. Pest control approaches fall into four main catagories which are following:

  1. Mechanical Pest Control Methods:

Physical pest control method is the oldest and most practical approach to eradicate pests. A trained and experienced professional is required in this method. Mechanical pest control methods include:

  • Use of barriers is a common physical method in which boundaries are set for the pests.It is an eco friendly method and long lasting solution. It commonly involves  the installation of windows and doors at public spaces, offices and homes. These windows not allow the mosquitos, cockroaches, rodents and other pests to get entry which control pests population before they start infestation.
  • Physical removal techniques may involve the practically picking of pests such as larvae or caterpillars from the plants. It is cost effective method involves the targeted pest control.
  • Suction and trapping is a versatile method in which beer devices are used to catch pests which are placed in their path. Suction tools are helpful in getting their larvae for identification. This method needs very less maintenance and lowers toxicity risks.

Pros:

  • Physical pest control is an eco-friendly method.
  • In this method there is no danger for the people, crops and pets as no chemical is used.
  • There are not much restrictions between the method used and the variety of pest species.
  • Mechanical pest control is easy to handle as no proper experts are required.

Cons:

  • This method is considered mostly as time consuming as proper physical setup is required to tap pests.
  • In the view of some people it is considered as inhuman to trap animals such as rodents etc from their habitat.
  • Physical pest control can not be used at a broad rate as pests have their larger communities than mechanical management will become tricky to handle.
  • This method is not a permanent solution as pests can again inhabit there.
  1. Chemical Pest Control Methods:

Chemical pest control methods may include use of pesticides in managing the infestations of pests. Pesticides are to be used according to the labeled amount and way. Experienced or professional service should use this method because chemicals can be toxic and can cause damage. Chemical pesticides are divided into three categories:

  • Insecticides are commonly used against insects such as cockroaches, flies, bedbugs, caterpillars etc. They interfere with the life cycle of insects. Bacillus thuringiensis is a commonly used insecticide.
  • Rodenticides are commonly used for mice and rats.These pesticides are toxic so they are used carefully.
  • Herbicides are used against weeds and unwanted small plants. They are commonly used in the lawns by gardeners to eliminate unwanted weeds which hit the beauty of gardens.

Pros:

  • Chemical control is a fast method in stopping the population of pests.
  • This method irrespective of physical method can be used for the broad ranged population of pests.
  • Pesticides are cheap and are simple to use.

Cons:

  • In chemical control there is a danger for humans, pets and pollinators.
  • This method requires proper training to use pesticides.
  • Continuous use of a pesticide can make resistance in pests against that particular pesticide.
  1. Biological or Biorational Pest Control Methods:

Biological pest control method is the oldest way in which a natural predator of a particular pest is used to control the population of pests.These predator or parasite relation may involves:

  • Larvae and adult lady beetles act as predators of aphids and other soft bodied insects.
  • Green lacewing larvae which eat spider mites.

Pros:

  • Biological methods have no toxic effects for mankind and pets.
  • It is commonly used once and gives long term management.
  • This is generally an environmentally friendly method and does not require much struggle of humans.

Cons:  

  • If the population of predators spreads more they can damage the beneficial insects.
  • Introducing a different species may damage the food chain or cause more infestation.
  • This is a very slow process and maybe the predators will not wipe out all the pests.
  1. Sanitary Pest Control Method:

Sanitation based pest management involves the maintenance of hygiene to prevent pests production.It involves deep cleaning, waste disposing, preventing moisture, destroying nets, temperature control etc.

Pros:

  • This is an eco-friendly and safe method which never involves toxicity.
  • Sanitation is cost effective and has no burden on budget.

Cons:

  • Proper sanitation management is required for this method.
  • Regular inspections become necessary for their work.
  • It involves slow action and has limited scope to manage the population of pests.

Pest Control Uses

Uncheck spreading of pests can give worse consequences so pest control plays its major role in controlling or eliminating them. Pest control has many purposes to done, some of them are following:

  1. Kill Pests:

The main use of pest control is killing pests by different methods.If the growth of pests is allowed uncheckily like little bedbugs can form large colonies which will become tricky or hard to handle.

  • Pest control will stop the spreading and growth of pests.
  • Pest control stops the spreading of pests to neighbouring property and spaces likely to get pests attack.
  1. In Agriculture:

Pests can damage 80% of crops if left unchecked, pest control disrupts the spreading of diseases caused by pests and their spreading to other local spaces in farms. In this way the quality and quantity of crops will improve.

  1. To Control Diseases:

Pests cause many diseases and due to germs they spread to other places, pest management kills and reduces the pests which transmit the diseases. Controlling pests such as mosquitos, ants, cockroaches prevents from the transmission of diseases such as asthma, malaria and many other allergic diseases. 

  1. To Maintain Hygiene:

Pest management never allows the pests to get entry in the public spaces which helps in maintaining hygiene. Pests detect the presence of food and start contaminating it, in this way pests become a challenge for the food industry. So in this way pest control manage them outside the homes, restaurants, and buildings. 

  1. Prevent From Future Infestation:

Pest management gives the inhospitable environment for the pests by doing proactive measures, which never allow the pests to get entry and create mess.

Pest Control Benefits

Professional pest management gives a comfortable life to pest free homes which are following:

  1. Protect Property and Buildings:

The pests like termites and rodents destroy the shape of wood and buildings. They also cut the electric wires and destroy the whole property. Pest management or control keep the pests away in this way, protect our buildings.

  1. Better Crop Yield:

Pest management at agriculture sites not only gives a healthy crop but also participates in increasing its quality by keeping pests away from crops in this way pest control proves itself beneficial for mankind.

  1. Health Protection and stress reduction:

Pest control eliminate the pests which causes the diseases and spread these diseases in this way it lowers the chances of allergies and illness caused by bacteria and other pests. Although anxiety and stress is removed to some extent by eliminating all the rodents from home and sleep quality also increased by removing bedbugs. In this regard pest management gives a way to mental peace.

  1. Cost Beneficial:

Early detection and early removal of pests from homes proves beneficial although if pest growth is let uncheck then its overburdened species will become difficult to handle. Pest control keeps you away from medical expenses by timely elimination of pests.

  1. Improved Comfortable Life:

We all want our homes clean in this regard pest management services give us pest free homes. You can live without any worry about cockroaches or ants reaching to your kitchen or bedbugs heading towards your bed.

  1. Better Healthy Food:

Where pests like cockroaches, termites, fruit flies and others are always heading towards kitchens, restaurants and cafes pest control closes all their ways to reach food and gives or provides us nutritious clean food. 

Pest Control Tips

When pests enter your home or any living space then it will become crucial for you to stop its population to be safe from damage done by them. Following are some tips you have to follow to get freedom from them:

  • First identify the variety of pests and take precautions by yourself.
  • Get knowledge about the pest species with this you will be able to understand the life stage of the pest and the things which are dangerous or beneficial for it.
  • Now consider a proper approach of integrated pest management to prevent pest population.
  • Apply proper strategies and precautions if you are using a dangerous method like chemicals.
  •  Now after killing all pests dispose them properly in inaccessible places from children and pets.
  • After getting rid of pests make the environment of your home uncomfortable for the pests to get entry into.

What are Pest Control Services?

Pest control services are licensed authorities which detect, manage and eliminate the pests. These services deliver safe strategies to kill or reduce pests ensure a hygienic and comfortable environment. There are many types of pest control services based on areas which work according to their standard strategies. The operations involved in the management of pests are daily inspections, planned treatments, pest identification, pest prevention and pest elimination or reduction.

List of Pest Control Companies in USA

You can talk to following 5 top companies if you need the best pest removal services.

  • Pathfinder Pest Control (located in Tulsa, Oklahoma)
  • Orkin
  • Truly Nolen
  • Rentokil Terminix
  • Arrow Exterminators

How Often Should Pest Control Be Done?

A variety of plans to control or manage pests are available, depend upon many factors. These period of pest control are:

  1. Quarterly in which pests are eliminated after 3-4 months. Mostly this is the standard pest control time in homes as many pests have seasonal population changes. 
  2. Monthly in which pests are killed or managed every month. This time line is recommended for infestations at large stage as done by cockroaches, rodents, etc and pests which contaminate food.
  3. Annually which involves the management of pests once in a year such as bedbugs.

Below are some factors which affect the time of elimination of pests:

  • Species of pest
  • Infestation rate
  • Location of living space
  • Humidity and temperature of space
  • Property type or condition

FAQs

Is Pest Control Worth It?

Yes, pest control is generally worth it with 75-90% reduction in pest population. Pest control gives a healthy environment with long term savings, seasonal protections from pests attack and provides a harsh environment for pests to grow or spread. 

Can Pest Control Get Rid of Rats?

Yes, professional pest management services can get rid of rats.To eliminate rats from homes and other working places pest control services use the method of trapping by using poisons or ultrasonic sensors in the pathway of rats.

Are Tenants Responsible For Pest Control?

Tenants are generally responsible for the pest control if infestation is caused by their poor cleanliness and unhygienic food storage, but if pests populate due to the property defects like termites in wood then landlords will be responsible for pest control.

Is Pest Control a Legal Requirement?

A contract of pest control is not necessary by the law, although it is the responsibility of business men and landowners to keep an eye on the pest risks of spreading. Protective measures should be followed to prevent pests.

Pest Control - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics

Insect Pest Control from Chemical to Biotechnological Approach

item.title: Eco-Friendly Pest Control: Types, Safety and Advantages
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
In today’s article you will read about the safe and secure methods for human health, animals and ecosystem. There are many strategies to control pests. But traditional methods which are used to control pests contribute to risk for our environment. That’s why we use eco-friendly products to get rid of pests and know the benefits of these products. We also discover techniques to prevent the entry of pests.

What is Eco-Friendly Pest Control?

Eco-friendly pest control means using safe, non-toxic and organic methods to control pests. Eco-friendly products are safer and sustainable for humans, pets and the environment.

Pesticides are used to kill pests. But these pesticides contain toxic chemicals which destroy human health, cause diseases and negative impacts on agriculture and surroundings. So that,

We should use the eco-friendly products which are not only the solution of our problem but also harmless for the ecosystem and humanity. Let’s start reading these methods.

General Methods of Eco-Friendly Pest Control

Here are some general methods for eco-friendly pest management.

Biological Control

Natural predators and parasites are used to control pests in this method. This technique is very efficient and risk-free for the environment.

For example, ladybugs are used to control aphids and nematodes targeted to soil-dwelling pests.

Companion Planting

When plants are growing together, some plants prevent pests and some attract them.

For example, marigolds can deter nematodes and basil can resist mosquitoes.

Cultural Practices

We can maintain soil health through mixed cropping, organic recycling, soil covering and crop rotation. These methods can help to keep the pests away.

Physical Barriers

Different barriers such as sticky traps, nets and covers are used to repel the pests. These strategies apply for rodents and insects.

Insecticidal Oils

When insecticidal oils are mixed with water and sprayed on pests. They work by cutting off the oxygen supply.

Eucalyptus oil is best for cockroaches and flies.

The smell of citronella oil keeps the mosquitoes away.

Peppermint oil is ideal to get rid of spiders and ants.

Homemade Remedies

Herbs are crushed, mixed with water and made into a solution. Apply this solution on these areas where you notice pests. Vinegar spray is very effective for ants. Use vinegar on the paths and erase them which are made by ants. This technique discourages them from coming back.

Specific Methods of Eco-Friendly Pest Control

Below are specific eco-friendly methods for pest control.

Diatomaceous Earth 

Diatomaceous earth is an organic and effective method used to control insects. This product can damage the internal framework of pests by absorbing the oils and waxes from their bodies. It causes them to dehydrate and die. Utilize it on your pets food storage containers, around your gardens, cracks and spiders living areas. 

Boric Acid and Bait Stations

Boric acid is a natural pest control solution. You can use bait stations to keep away pests. You can create a bait when you mix boric acid powder with peanut butter or powdered sugar. This process attracts them and compels them to carry it to their homes. This mixture will wipe out their colonies. 

Natural Pest-Repelling Wood

When we burn some types of woods like cedar,  teak,  hickory, camphor and red wood or use these woods in the form of furniture or buildings. It pushes away the insects because it contains natural oils and compounds which are toxic for them.

Neem Oil

Neem oil is a naturally derived solution and is used to prevent pests. When you use it with water and spraying it on your gardens and around the roots of plants before planting. It works by destroying the life cycle of insects.

Insecticidal Soap

This soap consists of potassium salts of fatty acid. It is helpful to manage soft-bodied organisms such as aphids and mites. When you use it with water and spread it on pests. It will remove the protective wax coating of insects and kill them by soaking the water.

See Also: How Often Do You Need Pest Control At Your Home?

Safety Measures For Eco-Friendly Pest Control

Following are the safety measures for eco-friendly pest control.

 Seal Cracks and Gaps

Fix all gaps or cracks around windows, doors and other openings which pests used to enter.

 Maintain Cleanliness

Keep everything neat and clean which is present in your home especially floors, kitchen and garden. Don’t leave dirty dishes in the sink and clean the spills.

 Install Window Screens

Insects also use doors and windows to enter. Introducing window screens provide clear or filter air and prevent pests. Repair all the holes which are present in windows.

 Compost Properly

Manage kitchen waste properly. Your compost bin must be sealed. Avoid adding meat, fatty foods and dairy products in it which attract the pests mostly.

 Maintain Proper Drainage

Make sure your drainage system must be carried through sealed pipe lines. Because poor drainage systems capture pests and cause different diseases such as typhoid fever, cholera and dysentery.

Store Food Properly

Foods, their crumbs and sugary items attract the pests. Cover the food and store it in sterilized containers and bags safely.

Vacuum Regularly

Daily based vacuuming keeps your home clean. It also eradicates insects,their eggs and larvae which are hidden in carpets, rugs and around furniture.

Keep Garbage Sealed

Don’t throw trash in open areas. Keep your garbage seal and dispose of it properly.

Fix Leaky Pipes

Fix all the leaky pipes in your home because standing water draws these insects and increases their growth.

Keep Your Yard Tidy

Keep your yard clean by trimming shrubs, grass and removing the rotten leaves. Maintain a specific sequence of your yard. Random or irregular manners provide the place for their living.

DIY Citrus Spray

Some insects hate citrus. Boil the citrus peels in water and make citrus spray. Apply it on the pests entry points.

What Are The Advantages of Eco-Friendly Pest Control?

The benefits of eco-friendly pest control are given below.

1. Eco-friendly products are affordable.

2. It reduces the number of pests.

3. These are safe for people and pets.

4. It protects the environment from any type of pollution and chemicals that are released while using pesticides.

5. These solutions are designed to target specific pests instead of killing all pests which  are beneficial such as pollinators, bees and ladybugs.

6. These products not only control existing pests but also wipe them out for a long time by destroying their reproductive cycle.

Conclusion

Eco-friendly products and methods provide, gentle, efficient and sustainable way to dealing with the problems of pest control. When you choose a good pest exterminator, you can contribute to a healthier environment and also protect your family and pets.

These products save a lot of money. It does not harm the plants and other beneficial insects. You also get rid of them by following the above preventive measures. We provide high quality environment friendly pest control service in Tulsa and nearby areas. Contact us for an urgent same day visit.

FAQs

Do coffee grounds keep bugs away?

Yes, coffee grounds repel the bugs, especially wasps, mosquitoes and bees. Because it is efficient for its strong smell, caffeine and diterpene content. When we burn coffee grounds it becomes more effective because its smoke keeps bugs away.

What is the safest organic pesticide?

The most safe organic pesticides are neem oil, insecticidal soap, spinosad and horticultural oils.

These are derived from natural sources and are non-toxic for humans. These are used to target mites, aphids and caterpillars.

What smell do pests hate?

Pests usually hate unpleasant,powerful and citrus smells which affect their senses. Natural aromas which are used to keep away pests include peppermint, citronella, lavender, eucalyptus, tea tree oil, cedar, rosemary, garlic and vinegar.

item.title: How Bed Bugs Start? Origin and Common Signs Explained
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
We all love a clean home. But unfortunately if bed bugs enter your homes, it becomes uncomfortable and annoying for you. After they start living in our home, it is actually very difficult to get rid of them. Bed bugs are small and brownish red pests that suck blood of humans and pets.

The problem of bed bugs is worldwide. Mostly they live on mattresses, coaches, pillows, bed frames, blankets, revolving chairs, and places where humans are available and come out of their host areas commonly at night when their prey is sleeping and near to them. 

Origin of Bed Bugs

According to the report of experts, bed bugs were as old as warm blooded animals. At start bed bugs feed on bats and warm blooded animals, but with the passage of time when humans started developing cities and towns and got permanent shelters, bed bugs started feeding humans blood.

The first case of bed bug disease was introduced in 1583 in England, then after several cases came to limelight in America, Africa and Asia. In the 20th century when trade was done at international level bed bugs travelled to other countries by luggage. Nowadays bed bugs are present everywhere, in homes, restaurants, hotels, offices, public places, airports, and movie theaters.

Relevant Reading: What is an Exterminator? 5 Types, Duties & When To Hire

How Bed Bugs Manage to Get Entry in Homes?

Bed bugs are not attracted towards the clutters or filths; the only reason for their entry in homes is their property of “hitch hiking” as they travel as long as they find an appropriate host to feed on.

Eradication of bed bugs is considered a tricky task, so before preventing their infestation you must have an understanding about the ways bed bugs start appearing in your home to block all of them. Keep exploring the article to understand that means of entrance, following are five ways through which bed bugs get entry to your home:

  • Travel Through Luggage

The most common way of entering bed bugs in your home is your luggage after your long trip. After your visit it is likely to have bed bugs in folds and zips of luggage. Travelling is the main reason for the spreading of bed bugs from one place to another if proper travelling hygiene is not followed as in this it is likely to have bed bugs from airplanes, hotels, and other temporary residences by clothes, bags and personal things.

Precaution tips

  • Before temporarily shifting to a hotel first properly inspect all the furniture and bed so that the risk of getting bed bugs can be lowered.
  • Keep your luggage away from bed and walls and not place it on the floor, use a rack to place your luggage.
  • After your trip, do a deep cleaning of your clothes and give them a hot dry to kill all the germs which can become the cause of bed bug growth in your home.
  • Used or Second Hand Furniture

The silent cause of bed bugs entry in your home is second hand furniture which you commonly buy from local garage or old furniture shops. The cracks and seams in that furniture may be the hidden places for bed bugs.

Precaution tips

  • Take an inspection of the furniture before bringing it to your home, give close attention to the cracks, dark spots, insects and folds.
  • Wash all the fabric parts of furniture and treat all the wooden parts with heat to kill the bed bugs.
  • Infestation Through Shared Apartments

Bed bugs can also enter your home if you have shared walls with victimized neighbours. The shared residences include apartments, hostels, and hotels are also a cause for the bed bugs population. Shared clothing, bedding, furniture and other room items give birth to bed bugs.

Precaution tips

  • Regular deep cleaning and team work of roommates can prevent bed bugs from getting entry.
  • Proper guidance should be given to the residents to avoid all the acts which can bring bed bugs.  
  • Be alert and inspect all your belongings, luggage, and clothes after leaving shared places or during shared residence.
  • Through Public Places

All of us go to public places including, market, movie theaters, restaurants, parks, resorts and other spaces daily. All this environment where a number of people go or pass is the major source for transferring signs of bed bugs to your home. Common transport buses, cars, taxis and trucks where a number of people encounter setting daily become sources of hitch hiking for the bed bugs.

Precaution tips

  • Take a bath and deep clean all your things after you come back from public places.
  • Take precautionary measures to avoid entry of bed bugs in your home.
  • By Sleepovers

Sometimes our per night or some day guests bring hidden bed bugs in your home along with their luggage. During night time stay of guest hidden bed bugs commonly in toys, bags, clothes and other infested items actively migrate to the host room.

Precaution tips

  • Inspect all the luggage of guests at arrival and put its luggage away from your personal home items.
  • After the guests leave your home clean and give heat to all the sleepover items.  

Starting stage of Infestation

  • Rapid Breeding

When bed bugs settled to a place they started rapid growth and increased their population as one mated female can produce enough eggs to start infestation. One female can produce 1 to 7 eggs per day and 200 to 250 in her complete life. 

  • Hiding of Bed Bugs

Bed bugs find hidden corners of room, folds of pillows and sofas and stitches of mattresses, only come out of their host space when their prey is near to them, at night. In this way bedbugs manage to live in your home.

  • Feeding

Bed bugs feed on human blood, which is necessary for their survival.Warm temperature and carbon dioxide (CO2) are two things which are required by bed bugs in their host, in this regard both requirements are fulfilled on the bed of humans. 

  • Spreading

If bed bugs once enter your home they potent to spread in other rooms of your home in this way bed buds control and management become necessary to stop their infestation.

Common indications of Bed Bugs Presence or Infestation

When bed bugs start infestation in your home they leave following signs behind them through which you can guess their presence:

  • Small dark spots of blood, smears and stains on your mattresses, couches, bed pillows.
  • Sheded exoskeleton or shells of eggs on room furniture or other items.
  • Small itchy red spots on your skin.

Conclusion

If you are in Tulsa and you want professional pest control service and bed bug exterminator, we are available 24/7. Let’s talk to you and we will provide you the best eco friendly service to remove all kinds of pest from your home or property. We have been serving in this industry for years and therefore use our top quality resources to give you and your family complete peace of mind.

People Also Ask

What Will Happen if You Ignore Pests?

Completely ignoring pests will give them space and full freedom to spread their population. A high increase in infestation of pests can lead to damage of your property and health risks for inhabitants and at the last stage it becomes tricky to get rid of them and then their elimination also becomes more expensive.

What Kills Pests Immediately or 100%?

The use of pesticides is the most common way to kill all the pests immediately. The extermination process is mostly used for rapid killing of pests. 

Do Bed Bugs Live in Pillows?

Yes, bed bugs can live in pillows, as if infestation of bed bugs spreads at the particular stage that mattresses and other furniture items become full of bed bugs then bed bugs start living in stitches, seams, folds and pillow cases.

What Triggers Bed Bugs to Come Out?

Bed bugs are commonly triggered to come out of their host places by presence of humans on bed, carbon dioxide presence, heat, human scent & darkness.

item.title: Is Pest Control Worth It? Cost & When You Need This Service?
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Homeowners and businesses mostly think if they should invest their money on pest control. You might also see many people choose scheduled pest control services and they spend thousands of dollars every year to get rid of them.

Well, today you will get an honest and expert answer for this question. After reading, you will easily decide if pest control is worth or not.

Is Pest Control Worth It?

Yes, pest control is worth it. You can handle them by yourself or call the professional pest control service. Professional pest control reduces 75-90% pest population. It provides peace of mind through preventive treatments and charges around $50-$90.

Here the question is raised: How much do we spend on pest management? In 2017, 

pest control companies in the United States generate almost $8.597 billion in revenues for protecting house and business owners from infestations. Examples of spending money on pest control are $250-$400 million on rats and $500-$1500  million on bed bugs. But after this expenditure you can save your house and business. 

Methods To Prevent From Pest Infestation

There are some preventive measures which keep pests at bay. If you follow these precautions you can reduce the chance of pests to damage your house and enjoy peace of mind year-around. These strategies are following:

  1. Close Entry Points

Check any holes, cracks and gaps in exterior walls, windows and doors in your home. If they are present then seal them by applying  weatherstripping and caulk for stopping the access of pests in your house.

  1. Store Food Properly

Store food items like cereals, and pet food, as well as fruits and vegetables in airtight containers for protecting them from pests. Also keep your kitchen counter and cabinets clean and free from food debris to inhibit pests from searching the food.

  1. Remove Standing Water

Make sure that there is no standing water in your yard. Because these are the breeding places of insects such as mosquitoes, and other pests. So, eliminate water from gutters, and leaky faucets. You can also use a dehumidifier to make your house less friendly to insects.

  1. Dispose of Garbage Properly

For disposing of garbage, you should use sealed trash cans with tight fitting lids, and clean them regularly. Also place the garbage bins at a distance from your house to reduce the risk of infestations.

  1. Cut Vegetations

Trim bushes, shrubs, and extra branches of trees to keep your house safe from pests. Because these are their living places and they can easily enter your home through them.

  1. Schedule Regular Pest Control Services

Pest control technicians can easily treat the pests because they have proper training about them. So, making a regular schedule for pest control services can protect you and your family from infestations.

When To Hire Pest Control or Do It Yourself

Some pests issues are common which you can easily handle such as

  • A single rat sighting (place traps in the right spots)
  • A few ants near a window or door (apply spray, close the gap)
  • Fruit flies from overripe produce (remove the source)
  • Occasional spiders in corners (vacuum them up)

     Other problems which are not handled by you, then call the pest control service.

Advantages Of Professional Pest Control Service

Professional pest control management services are helpful in case of infestations. If you do not take action against the first sign of pests, then it will cause a serious issue. So, call the professional pest control service when you need it.

  • Technicians Have Proper Knowledge and Equipments

To get rid of pests, you may need special equipment and knowledge about using them. Everyone cannot use these equipment to kill the pest. Only a trained person can make the best use of them without harming yourself. Some pesticides are also not available easily. 

  • Professional Can Provide Proactive Pest Control Service

If you don’t have current pest problems, you may not know how to face future pest issues. But professional pest control services know how to solve your problem and they give you the best solution to your problem. For instance,  they can check all the holes in your walls in one round and give you the best suggestion.

  • Professional Give Peace Of Mind

If you call a professional, then you shouldn't be concerned about the pest. You don’t need to do different strategies and waste your energy. Professionals will take steps and protect your house from pests.   

Cost of Pest Management

Pest control costs depend on the factors, like whether you need a one-time, or regular visit. Its costs are also based on types of pests, severity of the infestations, and area of your home. There are also cost differences between pest extermination and pest control.

  • One - Time Visit

If pest control service recognize and eradicate all the pests in their one visit, then you will be very lucky.  Because it will save your money. Their one-visit will charge you almost $300-$700.

  • Initial Visit

If you sign the ongoing pest control contract, your charges will be almost $250-$850 for the first advisory call. In this call, they will recognize the nests and entry points of pests. They will also discuss strategies to control them in this call.

  • Regular Treatment

If you want pest control service to check your house regularly, then you will pay monthly ($40-$45 per call), bi-monthly ($50-$60), and quarterly ($100-$300).

Pests That Need Professional Pest Control Services

While you have precautions against pests, but some pests require proper professional pest control services. These pests are following: 

  1. Termites

Termites are the pests which cause structural damage in your home. Their identification is very difficult. So, for their recognization and treatment, you should hire a professional pest control service.

  1. Rodents 

You try to trap the mouse yourself then it will not be safe for you and your family. Because rodents may cause allergies and other diseases. For saving your family from these diseases, call a professional rodent control which deals with them.

  1. Cockroaches

If you see a cockroach in your kitchen it means there are many cockroaches in your kitchen. These spread bacteria where they present. These bacteria cause illness in your family. So, call a professional cockroach control which will control their population and protect you from them.

  1. Spiders 

If spiders like garden spiders or daddy long legs are present in your home, then other pests will also be present there which will eat these spiders. These unknown pests also cause infestation in your house. For getting rid of them, call a professional spider control which will eliminate them from your house. 

  1. Ants  

Trail of ants can be killed with the help of spray but sometimes its use makes ant infestation worse. When the target ants do not reach their colony then, other ants sense the danger and increase their reproduction. As a result, a large colony is produced. It becomes a problem for the homeowners.  

  1. Bed bugs

Bed bugs are the worst pest which can be killed. But you can not control their large amount. To overcome their population, you will have to call a professional bed bug control, because they can easily identify their hiding places and eliminate them forever.

  1. Wasps

You can deal with small wasps but it will be difficult for large nests. Dealing with large nests will be dangerous for you because they can deliver hundreds of stings at a time. So, it is very useful to call wasps control technicians which have proper equipment to handle them.

Conclusion 

Surely, pest control is worth it for those people who are facing this problem. To overcome this trouble, you can hire a professional pest control technician or deal with small infestations by yourself. But dealing yourself is a time consuming process while a trained person will do it more efficiently and fastly. But the final decision depends on you.

FAQs

What are the signs of pest issues?

Common signs of pest issues are small holes in wood, fecal smears, grease marks, real sightings of insects and spiders, hearing scratching sounds in walls, finding droppings, detecting musty odors, seeing damaged food packing and wiring, and observing nests in hidden areas.

Do I need to wash everything after pest control?

No, you do not need to wash everything in your home after pest control. Because modern professional treatments use specific applications, so only clean your home from chemicals like insecticide and pesticide. 

Can I sleep in my house after pest control?

Yes, you can sleep in your house after pest control. But still waiting for 2-4 hours for chemicals to dry. Also follow the instructions of your pest control technician.

item.title: What Causes Bed Bugs? 7 Reasons, Signs and Identification
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Today's topic is about the causes of bed bugs. We will tell you about the causes, location and signs of bed bugs. You will know the interesting things about bed bugs. It will increase your knowledge about them.

This article will give you reasons of entering bed bugs in your house in detail. We hope that this guide will be helpful for you. Let's start today's discussion.

What Causes Bed Bugs?

Bed bugs enter your home by being attached to some things. They mostly enter your house with luggages and clothes. They are present in hotels, motels, public places and public transports. So, they come to your home with you.

Bed bugs are also present in secondhand furniture. When you buy this furniture then they get access to your home. Then they bite you and your family at night. They cause allergies and skin infections which disturb you and your family. 

There are many reasons of coming bed bugs in your house but the main reasons are following:

  • Traveling 

When you travel and stay in hotels or other places. Then during returning back to home, you do not check your luggages and they enter the home with your luggages. Then they disturb your house. 

  • Clothing 

When you go outside to some public place or use transport like bus and train. Then bed bugs present there attach with your cloth and come to the house with you. They cause problems in your home.

  • Lack of Cleanliness

Sometimes bed bugs attract to your house due to uncleanliness. When you do not keep your house clean then they come to your home. So, it is necessary for you to keep your house clean.

  • Secondhand Furniture 

Buying secondhand furniture is another reason of bed bugs in your house. When you buy used furniture, they already hide in it. Then they enter your home with the help of this furniture.

  • Public Spots

Bed bugs are present in public places. When you go there, they hide in your goods or clothes. Then they get access to your home with the help of you and create problems for you and your family.

  • Living Place Crowded

When you live in a hostel or in a small place where many other people are also living with you. The coming of bed bugs is a common thing in this situation. Because dirty and crowded places attract them.

  • Guest to Home

Bed bugs also come to your home with the help of guests. They attach with their clothes and bags. After entering your house, they start to live there  permanently.

Identification of Bed Bugs

Bed bugs are small pests which look like brownish-red bugs. They are about the size of an apple seed and are around 5-7 millimeters long. They mostly attack humans at night and suck their blood. After feeding, they swell and turn reddish.

They hide in beds, corners, cracks and those places where they could easily attack humans. They live in groups and do not make nests. They do not have wings. But they walk very fast on the floor, walls and ceiling.

Where Do Bed Bugs Are Found?

Bed bugs are small insects which can be easily hidden everywhere. They are mostly present at those places where they can easily catch humans. They come outside at night to sucking blood of humans.

In the house, they can easily hide in the mattress, furniture, corners and cracks. They may be present in between cushions of sofa, in curtain foldings, under carpets and in boxes.

They walk very fast. So, they move from one place to another quickly without knowing you.They are also found in hotels, apartments, shelters, buses, trains and other public places. 

Signs of Bed Bugs

Bed bugs leave signs behind them. Due to which you can easily identify them and take necessary steps against them. Some common signs which tell you about the presence of bed bugs are following:

  • See small red spots on your skin
  • Feel musty smell around bed
  • Note small black spots on bed sheet
  • Watch tiny red stains on pillowcases and sheets
  • See pale yellow eggs or eggshells

If you find these things around yourself, then you should know that bed bugs are present in your house.

When to Hire Bed Bugs Control Service?

When you are sure that bed bugs are present in your house and you want to eliminate them. Then you should call a professional bed bugs control service. They found them from their hiding places and will eradicate them. 

Bed bugs do not cause serious health problems but they cause allergies and other skin problems. So, to get rid of them is very necessary. For this purpose, you should call a bed bugs control guy.

Conclusion 

We know that the presence of bed bugs in the house disturbs you. They also create other problems for you and your family. The reasons for their entering your house are very common which you read above.

Now, if you are facing this problem in Tulsa, then you need to hire a bed bugs control person. We can eliminate them from your house and make sure your home will remain safe from pests in future. Contact us now!

FAQs

  1. What attracts bed bugs to humans?

Bed bugs are attracted toward humans due to these things: carbon dioxide we exhale and our body heat. These two things excite them to attach to us. 

  1. Do bed bugs hibernate?

No, bed bugs do not hibernate. However, they can enter a state of dormancy known as diapause during cold temperatures, where their development and activity slow down significantly until conditions improve.

  1. Can bed bugs live in pillows?

Yes, bed bugs can live and hide in pillows. They especially hide in the seams, folding and under pillowcases. Where they can easily attack humans and suck their blood.

In this guide we discuss the infestation of bed bugs in America. You learn which cities have high levels of bed bugs and what are the reasons for their spread. We also explain what are the problems which bed bugs create and how to deal with them.

What are Bed Bugs?

Bed bugs are small and reddish-brown parasitic insects. They can live on the blood of humans and animals. Their size is about the size of an apple seed. They are oval, flat and swollen after feeding on blood. Bed bugs are found almost everywhere such as hotels, schools, offices, residents and public transportation.

Some of their type depend upon warm blooded animals including birds and poultry for their food. They hide during the day and come out during night to take blood. They are active during the night so finding them is very difficult.

Top 50 USA Cities Which have Worst Bed Bug Infestation

Bed bug infestation is not limited to specific areas but the expansion has been clearly noticed in many cities of the USA. According to the research following are the cites which have high concentration of bed bugs.
