Causes and How Do Bed Bugs Spread So Easily?

Bed bugs do not appear suddenly but they hitchhiking from one place to another which is already affected. Bed bugs don’t have wings but they are quick to move and cling to clothes, luggage, backspack, furniture and second hand items. Increased international travel also has accelerated the spread of bed bugs. Foreign people carry bed bugs with them into the country.

They can move within walls, through floors, ceiling openings and on pipes. Thus they make ways to enter your home. They are small in size and easily hide during the day. Bed bugs are not attracted to dirt or mess but they can seek in from public transportation, hotels, motels, apartments, dorm rooms and movie theaters.

How Do Bed Bugs Affect Human Health?

Bed bugs basically affected the humans by biting. Bed bugs biting create rashes and redness problems on your skin which show in the form of clusters or lines. They also cause allergic reactions, mental stress, sleep disturbance, anxiety and iron deficiency which are also called anemia.

Rubbing can also damage skin. It leads to bacterial infection such as impetigo, cellulitis, ecthyma or folliculitis. The bed bug which highly affects humans is called climax lectularies. It increases its size upto 50% and weight 200-150% after feeding.

Signs To Identify Bed Bug Infestation

You can’t feel bed bugs immediately. Some people don’t have a quick reaction but after some time they notice red marks on their skin. These bite marks may take 14 days to develop in a few people. The symptoms which indicate the presence of bed bugs are given below.

  • Blood stains on your mattress and sheets.
  • Small black spots.
  • Tiny eggs or eggshells.
  • Small yellow skins.
  • An unusual smell around your bed.
  • Real bed bugs on box spring, head boards and mattress.

How Can Americans Control Bed Bugs?

Following are a few ways to control bed bugs.

1. First of all, you have to remove randomness from your room. As a result, bed bugs will not be able to find any place to hide.

2. Next, you can also use safety cover for your mattress and box springs. We recommend you to see other holes in your house as well. If you find them, close immediately.

3. Then you need to place your bag into your dresser, table or suitcase. Don’t keep it naked on the floor or on bed if you plan to stay outside of your home. Wash all your clothes and dry them in a hot dryer after you return home.

4. You should wear those dresses which cover your body completely. 

5. You must also regularly vacuum your house and other nearby areas. After this, vacuum cleaner bag should be placed carefully in plastic bag. Then you have to throw this in trash.

6. You should repair the cracks in walls and close all bed bugs entry point.

7. You have to wash your bedsheets and curtains in hot water. Then dry them in the dryer machine.

8. At the end, you need to consult with pest control services. When you notice bed bugs symptoms such as removing skin, stains of faeces and blood in your home.

Interesting Facts You Should Know About Bed Bugs

Below are some amazing facts which every person must know.

  • Bed bugs can lay 1-5 eggs in a day and more than 500 in their whole life.
  • Bed bugs can tolerate a wide range of temperatures from freezing point to 122 degree Fahrenheit.
  • They can survive several months without any meal.
  • Bed bugs can feed about 5 minutes before retreating to digest.
  • They can take blood seven times more than that of their body weight.
  • The nymphs are so small that they pass through the hole of the stitch in a mattress.

Conclusion

Bed bug infestations can be very annoying. They are rising nationwide in the USA. Bed bugs don’t spread disease but they cause different types of problems such as Itchiness,rashes and allergies. You can take above precautions to prevent the spread of bed bugs. When you notice bed bugs and their symptoms around your surroundings you should contact professional bed bug extermination services.

FAQs

What 100% kills bed bugs?

The only method that 100% kills bed bugs is high heat treatment. Increasing the home temperature upto 120F-140F removes all hidden bed bugs and eggs. Steam cleaner is also used for this purpose. When heat treatment of the entire home is done professionally. It eradicates all bed bugs and their stages.

How do you draw bed bugs out of hiding?

Bed bugs are drawn out of hiding by detecting carbon dioxide and heat. Bed bugs are attracted to carbon dioxide which humans also release. Heat also compels them to move and come out. Interceptors are placed under the legs of bed and sofa to trap bed begs.

How many times can a bed bug bite you in one night?

A bed bug bites you several times in one night depending on hunger. They bite mostly in a line or cluster. Bed bugs continue feeding until they are full completely. It usually takes 3-10 minutes. When you move they take a short break and start again.

item.title: Are Tenants Responsible For Pest Control? See Expert Answer
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
In this article, you will read about the responsibilities of tenants and landlords. You will also know how to control pests from your apartment. We hope our information will clear all the questions which come to your mind about pests control. So, let’s start today topic:

Are Tenants Responsible For Pest Control?

Tenants are responsible for pests control when pests enter your house due to the tenants. When tenants do not keep the house clean then it invites the pests in the house. When pests start living in homes then they disturb both the tenants and landlords.

 So, to get rid of pests is very necessary. For this process, take care of cleanliness and close all the entry points of pests. Act on preventive measures which keep pests away from your house.

Duties of Tenants

First of all, it is the responsibility of house owners to ensure the home is free from pests. Then give the house on rent. When tenants take the home on rent then it's their duty to keep the house safe from insects. There are the following tips which should be adopted by the tenants.

Keep Cleanliness

If you are a tenant then you should keep your apartment clean and do not throw garbage. A clean house is also liked by everyone. Trying to keep your home neat and clean so that pests remain away from you and your family.

Garbage Disposal

It is the tenant's duty to dispose of the garbage from your portion regularly. Because trash is the main source which attracts pests. Keeping garbage in the house and not throwing it can cause other diseases and problems. 

Cleaning Crumbs

Small pieces of food and crumbs are the main source of infestation. You should keep your kitchen and dining table clean properly and should not throw food particles carelessly. Keep cleanliness which decreases chances of pests in your property.

Take Care of Pets

Give baths to your pets regularly and not keep them dirty. Because dirty pets attract pests more which can disturb your pets. To save them from pests keep them clean and away from dirty things

Checking Pest Issues

It is the duty of tenants to check the entry of pests in their apartment. If you see any pests then immediately take action against them. If you do not control them then they will become a serious issue for you and your family.

Duties of Landlords

The major responsibility of landlords is to provide a healthy environment and save houses from pests. Landlords should fulfill the requirements of tenants. They should follow the precautions and other tips which keep their house safe from pests. Main duties of landlords are following:

Inspection and Maintenance

Checking of your property is the major duty of landlords. They are responsible for protecting their house from pests. If your house has pests then nobody will like to live in it. So, save your home from pests.

Pre-Tenancy Pest Control Treatment

It is the landlord's duty to make their house free from pests before giving it on rent. So that tenants live in their homes peacefully and happily. Landlords should apply spray, fumigation and other methods to keep their property safe from infestation.

Providing Healthy Environment

A healthy environment can be provided by keeping your home neat and clean. This thing will save your house from insects and tenants will like to live in such pest free houses. 

Repairing Structural Issues 

Pests such as termites cause damage to structures which makes your house ugly. Then nobody likes and want to live in your house. Damage structures also attract pests. So, repairing your home is very necessary.

Take Actions Immediately

When you see any pests in your home then take action against them quickly. Don't leave them free because then they will create a big problem for you. So, implement the strategies which eliminate pests from your home.

Hiring Professional Pest Control

When pests are not controlled by you then call a professional pest control person. They will solve problems and ensure your house is safe from pests in future. They also eradicate pests from your property quickly and permanently.

Signs of Pest Infestation

When pests enter any house or property and start living in them. Then they are detected by their signs. Pests left marks behind there which indicate their presence in your house. Common signs of pest infestation are following:

  • Structural Damage

When you notice structure damage in your apartment then understand it is the work of pests. It indicates pests are entering your house. Because some pests like termites damage structure. So, take action against them.

  • Finding Nests

Finding nests from trees and walls is also a sign of pests' presence. When you see their nests then remove them from that place. Adopt those methods which eliminate them from your home.

  • Bad Smells

Some pests have a bad smell which indicates their presence. When you smell in your apartment then understand there are pests present. Try to find and eradicate them from your house. 

  • Eating Food

When you find small pieces of bread and half eaten food from corners then these things tell you the presence of pests. It is very necessary for you to get rid of them. So, take proper steps to kill them. 

What To Do Tenants When Find Pests?

If you are a tenant in any rental property and find the pests in your portion then it will be unexpected for you. In this situation, you should not be worried. First of all check your agreement which is done with land lords. If it is written in contract that pests controlling is the responsibility of the landlord then they will eliminate pests from there.

If you don't want to live in this house then it is also your right to leave the apartment and take your advance back from the landlord. You will also be independent in breaking the contract which is done between you and the landlord. If pests enter your portion due to your unhygienic activities then it is your duty to keep the house clean and make it free from pests. 

Tenants Pest Control Rights

When land lords could not control the pests and not fulfill the requirements of a tenants then a tenants has the following rights: 

Withhold Rent

If you are a tenant in a building and facing the pests problem in it then it is your right not to pay the rent to your landlords until they solve the pests problem. When they eliminate pests from your apartment then pay your rent.

Shifting and Break the Agreement

Some contracts are done for a specific period of time but when you find pests in your portion then if you want to break the agreement and want to move to another area then you can do this. It will be your right.

Move Into Temporary House

If your rental apartment has pests issues and you do not want to leave this house. Then it's your right to move to a temporary house until the landlord solves this problem.When pests are eliminated from your house then return back to this home.

When Should Tenants Be Responsible For Pest Control?

When pests enter your house due to the irrelevant activities of the tenants then they are responsible to eliminate them. When tenants do not take care of cleanliness then it invites pests and causes infestations. Tenants should keep their portion clean and dispose of garbage regularly.

Tenants should take care of their pets' cleanliness. They should give them a bath on a daily basis. Because if their pets will remain dirty then they will attract fleas which will cause flea infestation. 

What To Do When Landlords Not Take Action Against Pests?

When land lords do not take action against pests then you can take the help of any authorities. If they fail in solving the pests problem then you have a right to leave this house. In this condition, you can break the agreement which is done between you and your landlord.

You are also free to take help from any government council which is responsible to solve your problem. If landlords solve the pests issues then you do not need to take any action against them.  

Steps To Take When Tenant Report Pests

When your tenants report you about the presence of pests in their apartment then you should to take the following steps:

Check Your Contract

Firstly, you need to check your agreement with them. If your contract is not expired then you should solve their pests problem and provide them a pests free portion for living. Then tenants will stay in your house happily.

Save Your Investment

If you are facing the pests problem and your tenants also disturb due to this issue then you should treat the pests problem immediately. As a result, you can save your investment and stop your tenants from moving to other houses.

Document The Cause

If your tenants are the cause of pests issues in your house then you can write all the complaints in the document and send them as a notification. This document will help you when they will not agree on paying charges.

Call For Professional Pest Control

When you and your tenants are failing in controlling the pests problem then you should hire a professional pest control guy which will solve your issue efficiently and quickly.

Final Words

First of all, landlords are responsible to provide a healthy and pest free house to the tenants. Landlords should ensure that their apartment has no pests issue then they give it on rent. Tenants will be responsible to control pests when pests come into your home due to tenants.

If you are facing the pests problem in Tulsa Oklahoma and want to get rid of them then you need to hire a professional pest control person which will eliminate pests from your apartment.

item.title: Pest Control vs Exterminator: A Detailed Comparison & FAQs
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
It’s the middle of night when you notice some unwelcomed cockroaches in your kitchen. You use your mobile to search its solution on google. You will see two services pest control and exterminators, you are a little bit confused in choosing the one service based on your requirement as both services have same goal of eliminating pests but have different methods and strategies to do so.

This article comprises all the main differences between the pest control and exterminator, gives you complete guidance about taking a decision in choosing the one best approach.

The Term Exterminator Means

Exterminators are the professionals who provide extermination of pests. Extermination is reactive and instant elimination of pests from homes, buildings and other affected working places. Extermination involves the use of pesticides or fumigations to manage or reduce pests.It is an one time service with emergency responses and also require follow ups.

The Term Pest Control Means

Pest control is professional service involving the removal, management and killing of pests present at places occupied by people. Pest control includes different methods, mechanical, chemical, sanitation and biological according to the variety and population rate of uninvited guests.

Major Differences

Pest control and extermination has many key differences which are following:

  1. History

Pest control:

Pest control was introduced many years ago, roughly it is considered as old as agriculture itself since 2500 BC. Ancient pest control involves the use of, sulphur compounds to treat pests like insects and mites, arsenic and mercury compounds to control lice and other pests, Sea water to remove weeds. With the passage of time many more chemicals and approaches or techniques were developed in pest control.

Extermination:

Extermination was completely introduced in the 20th century, after the second world war in 1939 DDT (Dichloro-Diphenyl-Trichloroethane) was invented, a powerful insecticide which opens the doors towards exterminators. In this regard extermination era is characterized by use of many chemicals as pesticides.Extermination is an aspect of whole pest control circle.

  1. Scope or Range

Pest control:

Pest control has a broad range of solutions,aims to manage pests along with killing or reducing them. Pest control include management, prevention, maintenance and elimination of unwelcomed creatures.

Extermination:

Exterminators have a narrow range of pest management,they only have the strategies to kill the pests but give no ways to prevent pests from entering our homes.

  1. Strategies

Pest control:

Pest management is a proactive and reactive approach which gives long term service. It is an environmentally friendly approach which claims to protect the users and gives maintenance to get prevention from harms of pests. 

Extermination:

Extermination involves all the reactive strategies to kill pests.It is a quick approach, uses harsh strategies which can cause damage to users and its toxic chemicals can give significant crisis to the environment. 

  1. Targets or Goals

Pest control:

Pest control aims to prevent future infestations and slow proceeding to manage pests. It gives permanent solutions to prevent pests and make homes pests free.

Extermination:

Extermination is a band-aid process in which quick elimination of pests is done but it never gives permanent solutions of preventing future infestation.

  1. Techniques Used

Pest control:

Pest control uses natural and scientific methods to prevent pests including integrated pest management (IPM), sanitation, biological nontoxic treatments, conditional solutions etc.

Extermination:

Extermination gives quick knockdown of pests by using toxic pesticides, fogging (fumigation), and intense baiting for one time management.

  1. Cost Expenses

Pest control:

Pest control gives long term permanent solutions in one service which make it less expensive and budget free. After one check of pest control team no follow ups are required if we will follow strategies to clean our houses.

Extermination:

Exterminators never give a permanent solution and further follow ups or inspections are required to keep pests away from home. So it is an expensive service that includes regular inspections of exterminators. 

  1. Time Required

Pest control:

Pest control takes roughly hours to days but gives permanent results. In this method there is no need to seal the house for days to weeks, homeowners can live in houses along with the pest operations of control.

Extermination:

In past when extermination was done in homes homeowners had to stay outside the house for hours to days because extermination leaves smell of toxic chemicals in homes and direct interact with that smell or fog can cause health issues. In this regard, extermination is considered a time consumer. Although regular inspections of exterminators are also time consuming.

  1. Safety Ratio

Pest control:

Pest control involves the use of nontoxic pesticides, sanitation methods, cultural techniques and natural biological predators used to prevent pests which is an eco-friendly service. 

Extermination:

In the process of extermination, exterminators use toxic pesticides which harm the environment and users who apply fumigations on pests. 

  1. Peace of mind

Pest control:

Everyone aims to have their homes spotless, whenever pests manage to enter in their homes pest control gives permanent solutions and gives prevention of future infestations. In this regard pest control provides complete peace of mind to residentials.

Extermination:

Extermination treats symptoms not causes so in this way pests are not permanently eradicated from homes they can again manage to enter in homes, in this way homeowners never get their homes pest free ever.

Interactions With clients in Both Approaches

Pest control services have compassionate relationships with clients as they give peace of mind to clients in one time long term service. In this way pest control professionals make long term relations with clients by giving permanent solution of their problem.

When exterminators call into the homes the homeowners are in a hurry or want urgent relief from pests, in this way in this fast service homeowners are not interested in getting knowledge about exterminators strategies of removal of pests. Exterminator searches and kill the only visible pests and never give guarantee of their return.

A Possible Example

Lets take an example of bed bugs in your bed room, to handle them in both services pest control and extermination: 

Pest control

If you encounter bedbugs in your bed room, you will call pest control service, who will work according to their strategies such as:

  • Investigation of the variety of bedbugs.
  • They will use gel baits, traps, barriers or will spray a pesticide or will use any mechanical method according to the requirement or need.
  • They will eliminate all the bed bugs and will guide you on sanitation and cleanliness methods.
  • After management or removal of all the bedbugs they will offer latter inspections according to the need.

Extermination

If after encountering of bed bug you will call an exterminator they will work as:

  • They will use harsh pesticides to eliminate the bedbug.
  • They will kill all the visible bed bugs.
  • After completion of the whole extermination they will obviously leave the house within one to two hours but will leave a toxic smell of chemicals behind.

Pros And Cons of Each Service 

Both services pest control and extermination have their own advantages and disadvantages, which can help you in choosing the answer of the question,Which service you should call? are following:

Pest control

Pros

  • Pest control is a long term solution of pest colonies and prevents or manages future infestation while extermination gives low results.
  •  Pest control is an environmentally friendly option and is cost effective for you.
  • Pest control removes the cause of pests not only visible pests.
  • Pest control also involves methods of traps, barriers, gel baits, and other mechanical changes along with chemicals.

Cons

  • Pest control never gives immediate results as given by extermination.
  • To make pest control more effective regular sanitation and cleanliness measures should have to be followed.
  • Pest control has a higher initial cost.

Extermination

Pros

  • Exterminators give fast service to eliminate pests in one visit.
  • It is an effective service in which exterminators target the visible pests and eliminate all of them.
  • In extermination professionals and experts who have training on use of pesticides and identifying the pest works.
  • The extermination service saves your time in searching and buying different pesticides. 

Cons

  • The major disadvantage of extermination is the use of toxic pesticides which are dangerous for the environment.
  • As this is short term service so scheduled follow ups are required which become annoying for the clients.
  • Extermination can cause damage to your property or things with its dangerous chemicals.

Why Do Some Pests Always Remain Unmanaged?

Examples of folks in front of us who have used the services of pest management once or twice but still have pest problems. This is due to use of inaccurate methods to remove pests or real cause of pests is not removed.

  • Misidentification of pests
  • Use of temporary methods of management
  • Ignoring seasonal patterns of pests attack

If the real reason of pests attack will be cured or best service will be used than pests can be managed permanently for long times.

Common Confusions About Pest Control And Exterminators

Many people intermix the terms of pest control and extermination, they think pest control is only for invisible or small insects like bedbugs or termites and extermination is only for rodents or big sized pests. But the truth is both services aims the same to remove or kill pests of any species or variety but with different approaches. It does not matter which service you used but the which matters is whether the pests stay or move away. 

Which Approach is Best For Your Need?

The approach you have to work with is selected on the basis of various features such as:

  • If the variety of pests present is dangerous you should prefer extermination over pest control.
  • If pests have done severe infestation then you should also go with infestation.
  • If there are children or pets in the surrounding area then pest control is preferred or if there are empty places then extermination should be used. 
  • If you are looking for a permanent approach to get rid of pests then pest control is a better option.

Summary

For any type of pest control or extermination service in Tulsa and nearby areas, talk to us. We can arrange an urgent and immediate removal of all kinds of pests. Our team has been serving homeowners and businesses for many years. We know how to offer you a cost effective solution.

See this: How Often Do You Need Pest Control At Your Home?

Frequently Asked Questions

What are The Three Types and Cs of Pest Control?

The three types of pest control involves physical, chemical, and biological. All these types are used according to the need and sources available. The Cs of pest management which are followed when pesticides are used involves 1.Control 2.Contain 3.Clean up.

Do Exterminators Can Permanently Get Rid of Rodents?

Exterminators never give guarantee to keep rodents out of home permanently, they remove or manage all the infestation at present time but safety measures should have to be followed to keep rodents away from home permanently as attracted things in homes like food, contaminated plates, etc can become the reason of their return.

What are The Four Major Types of Pests?

Four major classes of pests based on their characteristics and damage done by them are insects ( cockroaches, termites, bedbugs, ants, fruit and house flies etc ), weeds (unwanted plants ), microorganisms (bacteria, fungi, viruses etc ), and birds ( pigeons, house sparrows, seagulls etc ).

item.title: Are Gophers Dangerous? Signs and Hazards at Your Property
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Today our topic is about are gophers dangerous? This article will give the answer to your question. It will also tell you about the signs of gophers' infestations and diseases which gophers spread in humans.We hope that our discussion will remain interesting for you. You will come to know about the extension of gophers' danger.

Are Gophers Dangerous?

Gophers are not dangerous for you and your pets directly but they damage your structures a lot. They are mostly present inside the ground and make mounds in your yards. They make holes in the ground which destroy your gardens badly. If your irrigation lines or cables are present underground then they can also chew them.

As gophers are not very dangerous but their holes can prove harmful for your children who are playing outside. While they do not bite directly to you but if they bite then they cause injury, carry bacteria and disease.

Signs of Gophers Infestations 

Gophers can be identified by their signs. The biggest sign of their presence is finding mounds and holes in your yard. They make a tunnel system which consists of chambers. These chambers are used to store food and nests. These chambers are all interconnected. 

Gophers damage the roots of plants, create holes in ground and chew underground things like cables and sprinkler systems. Major signs of gophers infestation are following:

  • Damaging Plants

Gophers mainly attack on plants. They eat the roots of plants. As a result, they wilt and die. If you note missing or wilting of plants then understand it is the work of gophers. 

  • Mounds of Dirt

Gophers create mounds in the ground which make your yard ugly. They mostly make crescent-shaped mounds. Due to these mounds, everyone dislikes your garden.

  • Sinking Ground

Tunnels which are made by the gophers, make the soil weaken. Gophers sink in the ground which makes the soil soft and uneven. In this soil, plants do not grow properly.

  • Tunnels and Holes

Tunnels and holes in your yard are also the sign of gophers. When your children are playing outside then there is a chance of trapping your children in it. That is harmful for them.

  • Yard Damaging 

Gophers damage your yard by creating tunnels in it. Using these tunnels, they eat the roots of plants. They also pull some plants from their roots. So, they play a main role in damaging your yard.

  • Soil Erosion 

Soil erosion is a common thing due to the gophers tunneling and mounds-building activities. They weaken the soil structure and increase the sedimentary runoff.

Need Help? Gopher Removal Tulsa OK | Pathfinder Pest Control

Diseases Spread By Gophers Bites

Gophers carry a number of diseases. These diseases can be spread to humans and other animals. Some diseases of gophers are curable but some are not. If you find gophers in your house then you should keep a distance from them.

Main diseases that are spread by gophers are following:

Rabies 

Rabies is a virus which directly attacks the central nervous system. Gophers spread this virus to humans by their saliva. It can also be spread when an infected animal bites you. Headaches, nausea and fever are its symptoms. If any gopher bites you and you feel these symptoms.  Then you should consult a doctor.

Hantavirus 

Hantavirus is a viral disease which attacks your respiratory system. It fills your lungs with fluid that causes difficulty in breathing. Symptoms of hantavirus are fever and muscle aches. If you are infected by the hantavirus then you should have to visit a doctor and start your treatment immediately.

Leptospirosis

It is a bacterial infection which is spread by contaminated soil or water. Gophers can carry bacteria in their urine which pass to humans and other animals through wounds. It affects your kidneys, liver and other organs. If you have leptospirosis then you need to consult a doctor.

Plague

The plague is spread through the bite of an infected flea. It is spread by bacteria which gophers carry in their fur. It is passed on to humans through the infected animals. Fever, chills and swollen lymph nodes are its common symptoms. If you notice any symptom then you should start your treatment.

Tularemia

Tularemia is also a bacterial infection. It is spread to humans by open wounds and cuts. This disease is curable by antibiotics. So, if you are infected by tularemia then you should consult a doctor and start your treatment as soon as possible. 

Treatment of Gophers Bites

If a gopher bites you then do not panic. You should wash those body parts where the gopher bites with soap and water. Then you have to apply any disinfected cream on infected areas. As a result, you will remain safe from infestation. 

Then you should get medical treatment from a doctor. Do not leave your wounds untreated. If you do not treat your wounds immediately then it will be proved untreatable in future.

Final Word

As you have read the answer of your question that gophers are not generally dangerous to humans and rarely bite them. But when you try to catch them by yourself then they can bite you. Their saliva has bacteria that causes serious diseases like rabies and plague. 

If you are facing the problem of gophers then we suggest you not handle them by yourself. You should keep a distance from them. For eliminating gophers from your house in Tulsa and nearby areas, you should call us now.

FAQs

  1. How do you permanently get rid of gophers?

You can permanently get rid of gophers by lethal trapping, exclusion and habitat modification. You can also install mesh fencing and wire baskets to protect individual plant roots.

  1. Are gophers afraid of humans?

Gophers generally fear humans. They spend most of their time underground. When they feel threatened then they can bite you otherwise they avoid to contact humans. 

  1. What do gophers hate the most?

Gophers mostly hate the strong scents like castor oil, coffee grounds, peppermint oil and aromatic herbs. They also dislike physical barriers such as underground wire mesh.

item.title: 4 Gopher Signs in Yard, How To Identify and How To Remove?
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
In today’s guide we read about gophers and their activities. Some people are very confused about gophers and moles because they live in the same habitats. You will learn how to identify gophers from moles and voles by their characteristics.

You will explore their signs in your yard. You will discover what to do next when you notice gophers in your yard or lawn. We will also explain to you what preventive measures should be taken to get rid of them.

How to Identify the Gophers?

The body parts of gophers help us to identify them. Gophers are also known as pocket gophers. Pockets are present in their cheeks which help them to carry food. They have small ears and eyes, tiny haired tail, flat head and large claws for digging. Their color may be black or brown and size almost up to 4-18 inches. Gophers have large front teeth also called incisors which are used for chewing.

They spend most of their time underground. They are experts in digging tunnels and burrows. They are found in north and central America.

Signs Indicate the Activity of Gophers in Yard

Below are few signs which indicate the presence of gophers in your yard:

1. Gopher Mounds

When gophers make tunnels they leave behind a mound. These mounds look fan or crescent shaped. The height of gopher mounds upto 3 inches. New gopher mounds appear at night especially when you water the lawn. One gopher makes multiple mounds of dirt in a short time.

2. Tunnel Opening

If you see holes or tunnels in your yard. It means your residential gopher may be busy with some work. Gophers close these holes or tunnels after completing his whole work and leave behind dirt on the mound.

3. Wilting Plants

When you notice wilting plants, cutting roots and uprooted plants after giving regular water to them. It may be that gophers are responsible for this. Because gophers eat the roots of plants. So that plant cannot take proper water and nutrients without roots, they wilt or die.

4. Soft or Sinking Soil

Your lawn soil becomes soft or sinking gradually as gophers make a number of holes. You will feel your lawn is soft under your feet, long raised lines and areas where tunnels sink. The soil of your yard becomes unstable.

Damage caused by Gophers

The destruction caused due to the activity of gophers are given below:

Landscaping Damage

Gophers make multiple holes and bring the underground soil above the land surface. They attack lawns such as cutting the grass, creating mounds of dirt, and uprooted plants. These are some reasons which destroy the beauty of landscape and create randomness.

Potential Spread of Diseases

Gophers can carry several diseases although the chances of direct contact are low.  Because they spend most of their time underground. Gophers cause various diseases such as LCM, Hantavirus, Leptospirosis, Rabies and Plague. These diseases spread when humans or pets come into direct contact with gopher feces, urine and saliva. Humans are also affected by biting the infected gophers.

Utility Damage

Gophers are not limited to chewing roots and plants. They can also destroy utility cables, irrigation drip lines and sprinkler systems. If you look at the unequal irrigation and dry spots. Gophers could be the reason for this.

What Are the Effective Methods To Get Rid of Gophers?

Trapping

Trapping is a safe and efficient method for a small population of gophers. The trapes such as Gophinator or Cinch and Macabee are set underground. These traps are placed in all entrances because you don’t know in which tunnel gophers are present.

After setting traps in all tunnels close them with dirt clods, sod, canvas or landscape cloth and cardboard or plywood. We do not recommend this method for large populations because of their complex burrows and tunnels.

Baiting

Baiting is also an important method to control gophers. Placing the bait in the central tunnel will be more effective. After detecting the central tunnel, place the toxic bait in it. Remove the light from burrows by closing them with layers of grass, dirt, cardboard and landscape cloth.

When you keep these bait in more than one tunnel it will increase the success chances. Using toxic bait for underground holes is legal. But using them on the above surface of land may be harmful for humans and animals. So use it carefully according to the given instruction. 

Exclusion Barriers

You can use barriers for keeping the gophers away and prevent your yard from damage. You need to protect your garden plants using a wire fence around it. Installing underground fences around the roots of plants and herbs of gardens. You must wrap the plastic net around the roots of plants and trees. You should grow the plants in raised beds and pots lined with mesh.

Use the land sketching fabric while growing the plants. These barriers are necessary to deter gophers because they chew the roots and damage plants. These barriers are more preventive measures than the solution to get rid of gophers.

Professional Gopher Control Services

If you are facing recurring gopher infestations and you have used almost all tacts. Now you become fed up and get rid of them permanently. It is the right time to contact professional gopher control services.

These companies offer inspection, eco-friendly treatment and fumigation to eradicate gopher infestation. These services also provide customized plans to protect landscape from burrow damage.

What Are the Precautions After Getting Rid of Them?

Following are the preventive measures from returning the gophers in your yard:

1. First of all, you should remove food sources such as fallen fruit and root vegetables. Gophers need food to survive.

2. Next, you have to use gopher resistant plants such as rosemary, lavender and daffodils. Because these plants keep the gophers away.

3. You must use underground barriers around the root of plants. These barriers can help to deter the gophers.

4. You should maintain your yard and reduce moisture. It is necessary to trim grass and keep it clean to minimize shelter facilities for rodents.

5. Lastly, if you notice gopher holes and their mounds, take fast action. DIY solutions do not provide long lasting results. You need to call an expert who has knowledge, experience and a certificate. Pest control companies create customized plans to eliminate gophers and keep your yard safe, healthy and hole-free.

Final Thoughts

If you observe the gopher signs such as crescent shape mounds, tunnels, utility damage and wilting plants. You must take action immediately to protect your yard in case you fail to handle them with DIY solutions.

You should consult professional gopher control Tulsa. Because we know how to identify their tunnels, which effective treatments are applied and prevent them from coming back.

People Also Ask

What Attracts Gophers To the Yard?

Gophers belong to the rodent's family. That’s why they are more attracted to vegetables, flowering plants, fruit trees, grasses and weeds. Because gophers need food to survive. They are also engaged in moisture and water sources. Moisture also helps the gophers in digging burrows and tunnels.

What Time of Day Are Gophers Most Active?

Gophers spend most of their time underground. But they are more active in the early morning, late afternoon and throughout the night. The intensity of heat is low and tolerable for them in these periods of time. They can do their work such as digging the burrows and holes without any stress.

A study has determined that they are more active during two periods, at night and in the afternoon. These periods are from 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM and 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. In these intervals, they came out of their tunnels in search of food.

What Smell Do Gophers Hate the Most?

Gophers mostly hate the castor oil, peppermint oil and coffee grounds. The smell of these products mask the food scents and irritate their senses. In addition, there are some other effective smells including rosemary, lavender, sage, eucalyptus and fish remnants. These are gopher repellent smells.

item.title: Bed Bugs Signs on Bed: 6 Easy Ways To Know Their Presence
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Are you having some unwanted pests in your bedroom and are not sure about their variety, if these insects are cockroaches, fleas, spiders or bed bugs? Now you want a proper guide on identifying these insects by their signs, in this article we have explained all the signs and information about bed bugs.

If you ever find signs of bed bugs in your bedroom then immediately call a pest control professional who can properly manage and eradicate them. 

Introduction

Bed bugs are reddish brown wingless small parasitic insects which commonly feed on the blood of humans and warm blooded animals. Bed bugs are hitch hikers which live as hidden unwanted guests in your home. Bed bugs always remain hidden and commonly come out of their locations at night or at day when their prey is near them.

Here are two main pieces of bed bugs:

  1. Climex hemipterus
  2. Climex lectularius

Bed Bugs Identification

Bed bugs are commonly confused with other insects although they have many differences from all of them. Differentiation or identification of bed bugs from other insects become easier if we know about their properties such as following:

  • Bed bugs are small wingless flat rounded insects which are reddish brown at adult or old age but have cream colour at birth.
  • The size of bed bugs is of apple’s seed and commonly are 6mm long.
  • Their eggs are white, sticky with unpleasant odour.

Common Signs of Bed Bugs at Your Bed

If the infestation of bed bugs starts it becomes difficult to get rid of them so along with structural properties of bed bugs it is necessary to know about physical signs of bed bugs to control or manage them at required time. It is crucial to find them before they find you.

Following are five major signs of bed bugs in your bedroom:

  1. Dark Spots or Stains

The dark and black dots on your bed sheets, mattresses, bedboards, pillows, and blankets is the sign of bed bugs' presence. These spots look like ink dots or ballpoint stains but these are fecal or extracts of bed bugs or whenever they are being crushed leave spots.

If these spots remain for a few days it will become difficult to wash or clean these stains.

  1. Live Insects

The presence of one or more live insects on your bed is the main sign of the presence of bed bugs in your bedroom. These insects can be seen by the naked eye but it is challenging to detect or catch them as they hide very quickly. 

  1. Blood Spots

Sometimes when you wake up in the morning you see blood stains on your mattress. These stains are due to bed bugs. When bed bugs bite your body or suck your blood at night they leave blood spots on the mattresses. Sometimes unconsciously a night you crushed bed bugs which leaves blood and extracts of bed bugs on your bed.

  1. Unpleasant Smell

The most common sign of bed bugs' presence is a silky smell which is produced by their scent gland in the form of pheromones. This smell is rusty like a wet towel.

  1. Exoskeleton of Bed Bugs

The exoskeleton of bed bugs is white in colour with translucent skin. Bed bugs shed their skin or outer shell many times during their growth which leaves evidence of their presence in your bedroom. Sometimes you also see broken legs of bed bugs on your bed which also shows the presence of bed bugs.

  1. Eggs or Egg Shells

You are cleaning your room and find many small white grains of rice sized egg collection under your mattress or sofa foam. These are actually eggs of bed bugs. Bed bugs place their eggs in favourable warmth which becomes an indicator of their presence. After the birth of the bed bug, shells of their eggs were left on the bed as proof of their presence.

How And Where to Look For Bed Bugs?

To check bed bugs presence first you should have a torch, a rigid paper, isopropyl alcohol in your hand so that you can easily find bed bugs with a flashlight and can sanitize the infestation place with alcohol. Use sticky tape to trap them, vacuum to suck them or a hairdryer to flow them away.

You can easily find them on the following sites:

  • In the seams, folds os stitches of sofas or couches
  • At the joints of drawer or other furniture
  • At folds of curtains or your clothes
  • Under wallpapers or photo frames
  • In boxes or books
  • At the headboards of your bed
  • At your mattress or blanket
  • Inside the pillow cover
  • In cracks of the wall or inside electric sockets

See this: How Often Do You Need Pest Control At Your Home?

How You Can Make Sure These are Bed Bugs Bites?

Bites of bed bugs are similar to that of other insects,you may be confused about which insect that bites you. Following are some signs of bed bugs bite with which you can identify whether it is bed bug bite or of some other insect:

  • There will be clusters of 3-5 bites together on your neck, legs, arms, or shoulders.
  • These scars on your skin will be small, itchy with darker purple skin.
  • These signs mostly you see in the morning and itchiness and welt will appear in the next few days or weeks usually.

Summary

We are professional pest removal service providers in Tulsa, Oklahoma and nearby areas. For several years, our company and team has been helping homeowners and businesses to remove bed bugs from their property. If you also need bed bug extermination service, please contact us now to get urgent help.

FAQs

Does Bed Bugs Presence Make Your Home Dirty?

Yes, bed bugs make our homes dirty because they leave many annoying things behind them. Bed bugs leave their dry skin, exoskeleton, egg shells, fractured legs, blood stains, fecal extractions etc. All this mess created by bed bugs sometimes never gets removed from bed after washing and it becomes a source of germs which can cause annoyances.

How Much Extent Bed Bugs Can Damage Your Health?

Bed bugs never directly cause diseases to inhabitants although they become  vectors for physical and mental health issues. Continuous increase in the population of bed bugs and stress about their removal or elimination makes you an anxious person, in this way they damage your health as slow poison. 

What Smells Attract Bed Buds?

Bed bugs are attracted towards humans natural odour, carbon dioxide released by humans, heat produced, dirty laundry, and sweat smell. Their prevention includes making the laundry clean without mess or clutter. 

What is The Behaviour of Bed Bugs?

Behavior and habits of bed bugs includes:

  • Biting of their host at night time.
  • They always want to live in hidden spaces or spots.
  • Bed bugs are attracted towards their host.
  • Hitchhiking is the main property of bed bugs they love.

Bed bugs have no wings to fly although they also do small jumps.

item.title: Bed Bugs Signs on Sheets: How To Check & Then Eliminate?
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Bed bugs are nocturnal insects which cause infestation. They create allergics and other problems for sensitive people. For eliminating them from home, it is necessary to identify them first.

So, today's topic is about the signs of bed bugs on your sheets. You will also read about their signs, bites and its treatment. This guide will be very helpful for you because it will tell you about their signs in detail. Let's start today's discussion.

Bed Bugs Signs on Sheets

Bed bugs are identified by the signs which they left behind them. After seeing their marks, you understand that bed bugs are present in your house. You mostly found small black spots on your sheets which is the sign of bed bugs. These spots will be about  the size of a dot.

Sometimes, you see reddish stains on your bedsheets or mattress in the morning. These stains are due to the killing of bed bugs by you at night. You accidentally crushed them when they were sucking your blood. If you feel a musty smell when entering the room then you know that bed bugs are present around you.

How To Identify Bed Bugs Bites?

Bed bug bites look like the bites of other insects like mosquitoes and fleas but there is a difference between their bites. Bed bugs usually bite on those parts of the body which are not covered. These parts may be arms, neck and face.

When bed bugs bite, they leave red pimples on skin. They mostly bite in a line that feeds, then move and feed. Sometimes, they bite in clusters. Their bites cause itching and allergic reactions. 

Some people are more sensitive as compared to others. As a result, they are badly affected by the bites of bed bugs. They get allergic reactions immediately after their bites.

Bed Bugs in USA: Worst Cities Listed and Interesting Facts

Treatment of Bed Bugs Bites

When you see the red small spots on your body then make sure that these pimples are due to bed bug bites or other insects. When you are sure that you are affected by a bed bug then wash your infected body parts with warm water and soap.

Then you should apply any anti-itch cream like hydrocortisone or other which is available. You need to avoid scratching them because it will cause infestation. Normally, it will take 1-2 weeks for recovery. 

If your skin is sensitive and bed bug bites affect you badly. Then we suggest you visit the doctor. They will check your infection and give you better treatment as compared to you.

Checking For Bed Bugs

Bed bugs are those pests which can easily hide in small places. Their size is almost the width of a credit card which helps them in hiding. If you are looking for bed bugs then you should check small holes and crack in your house.

You have to check the folding of curtains, piping of your bed, under the mattress and carpets. They may be present in the small cracks of your bedframe, drawers and in box springs.

Bed bugs hide in the daytime but they are active at nighttime. They attack people at nighttime when they sleep. Due to this reason, they hide near the bed so that they can easily suck their blood.

How to Eliminate Them By Yourself?

When you are confirmed that bed bugs are entering the house and creating problems for you and your family. Then you will want to eliminate them from your house. For doing this task, you should to follow these tips:

  • First of all, close all the holes and cracks that are in your house. Then repair other cracks which are present in your furniture.
  • You should check your luggage when you travel. Make sure that any bed bugs are not moving with you.
  • You have to place your goods on a dressing table or a simple table. Do not leave them on the floor.
  • You should use a high temperature steamer for eliminating them from  mattress, carpets, sheets and curtains folding. 
  • You need to vacuum your house regularly. Also clean the vacuum bag in a dustbin properly.
  • You have to keep your bed at least 6 inches away from walls and ensure no bedding touches the floor.
  • You should examine your house regularly. If you find any bed bugs then repeat all the process.

Should You Hire a Bed Bug Exterminator?

Bed bugs are not very dangerous pests but they cause allergics and other problems for you. When they are present in your house in large amounts and cause infestation. You do not want to control them by yourself and they are out of control.

Then you should call a professional bed bug exterminator. They are trained people and do their work quickly. They will prove helpful for you in this situation. They will secure your house from bed bugs permanently.

Conclusion

We know that seeing bed bugs signs on your sheets is very shocking for you. But when you identify them, you need to take steps against them. You should eliminate them by yourself if possible. If you do not want to eradicate them by yourself then it is not a big issue.

Then we suggest you hire a bed bug exterminator guy who does this work. If you hire a professional bed bug exterminator then you have to pay some money. But we will secure your house from bed bugs.

FAQs

  1. Does showering remove bed bugs?

Yes, showering with soap and water can remove bed bugs that may be crawling on your skin or in your hair, washing them down the drain. But they do not attach to humans like ticks.

  1. What brings bed bugs out of hiding?

Mostly the scent of carbon dioxide from sleeping humans, body heat and pheromones from other bed bugs brought them out from hiding places. Usually, they are active at nighttime.

  1. What time of day are bed bugs active?

Bed bugs are primarily active when humans are sleeping between midnight and 5 a.m. They hide in mattress seams, furniture joints and behind baseboards during the day.

item.title: 11 Important Types of Gophers You Need To Know in 2026
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Have you ever seen mounds of mud in your garden during morning walk, you would be shocked by them. Do not be afraid, all these mud holes are created by gophers who are living in your property as uninvited guests. Gophers are cool-blooded animals with pocket cheeks. Pocket cheeks of gophers are used by them to store food or transfer materials for their nests. 

Gophers are small rodents belonging to family geomydiae commonly found in America and Africa. To handle or manage all these rodents you have to learn about different types of gophers to eliminate a particular gopher from your property according to its weak points and behavior. This article comprises all the possible types of gophers so keep learning to get knowledge about them. 

Main Types of Gophers

Gophers consist of many types based on their living location, characteristics and habits. We will discuss all the types or major divisions of pocket gophers based on their genres and species.

The division of gophers based on their major genera is below:

  • Southern Pocket Gophers

The genera of southern pocket gophers is Geomys, commonly found in Mexico and US in deserts, plains or sandy areas. They have very large fore feet for digging and two sharp incisors. Mostly they live in large tunnels for their whole life. Its main species and sub species includes Desert, Plain & Texas pocket gophers.

  • Northern Pocket Gophers

These pocket gophers are mainly present in Canada and the northern US commonly in grasslands, pine trees and inhabit mountains. They are medium sized stocky rodents with brownish fur and eight in grams. 

  • Western Pocket Gophers

Western pocket gophers are commonly found in Canada, Central Mexico and California. They have Thomomys genera. They have no grooves on their teeth so have smooth teeth and are of large size, forming a large complex round tunnel system. 

  • Yellow Faced Pocket Gophers

Yellow faced pocket gophers are under Cratogeomys genera commonly found in Mexico and Southwestern US. They have only one groove on their teeth and are of yellow coloured skin.

  • Pappogeomys

This genera of pocket gophers is same as Catogeomys genera and mostly present and Mexico so commonly known as Mexico pocket gophers.

  • Tropical Pocket Gophers

These gophers are commonly found in central America and Mexico. They are large in size and mostly live in tropical areas.

The following types of pocket gophers are major species of gophers:

  • Botta’s Pocket Gophers

Botta’s pocket gophers have their variable sizes and skin colour but commonly have small eyes and small ears with the soil colour of their body. They have long catlike whiskers to feel the underground tunnels and strong claws for digging. Botta’s pocket gophers are mostly present in California and USA and want to live in agricultural places, deserts and other terrestrial areas.

  • Giant Pocket Gophers

Giant pocket gophers are under Orthogeomys genera, commonly found in Mexico and Central America, prefer soft vegetative soil for digging. Particular structural properties of giant pocket gophers are; presence of lined fur pouches, hairless tail and they have big claws for digging. 

  • Plains Pocket Gophers

Plain pocket gophers are a large species commonly present in North America grasslands. They have large claws for digging and a medium sized body with white inside pouches. Their habitat includes sandy areas, deserts and plains.  

  • Desert Gophers

They are “soil engineers” aiding soil aeration by digging large deep tunnels. These small rodents are commonly present in West Texas and Northern Chihuahua. They have large forelimbs for digging and a short hairless tail. Their common habitat is sandy deserts where their predators also present such as snakes, owls, hawks, and weasels. 

  • Mazama Pocket Gophers

Mazama pocket gophers are small burrowing rodents who are native to Northwest prairies. They form nutrient filled mounds with strong digging claws.

Will Gophers Cause Damage to Your Property or Yourself?

Gophers damage your property by making soil mounds. They make dirt mounds in your lawns which can affect the beauty of your lawn. Underground large tunnels created by gophers can damage underground water pipes, cables and wires. Their tunnels and soil mounds make the soil foundation of homes uneven which increases the risk of collapse and tripping risks.

Gophers can carry pathogens and can cause diseases. Their bite also is dangerous for your health.

How You Can Get Rid of Gophers?

Getting rid of gophers becomes difficult when they start making underground tunnels. Following are some methods you can use to eliminate gophers:

  • Trapping is the main method to capture gophers, make tunnels with fresh mounds and leave it by inserting traps in both directions and check it daily.
  • Place toxic baits or chemicals near tunnels of gophers. Use repellents to keep them away from your property.
  • Use large barriers or wire mesh to restrict their entry in your property.
  • Flooding is the method of eliminating gophers in which garden hose is flooded in their tunnels.

Many pest control services allow management or elimination of gophers, our service, Pathfinder pest control also provides its services to eliminate gophers from your property or home. 

Summary

If you are a resident of Tulsa and are fed up with gophers, attacking your property or home then we have its solution by giving you our pest control service. We have experience of many years in controlling and eliminating pests including gophers. If you want to take our service then we will be available with no off hours to you and will give satisfactory results by using all our best resources. Let’s talk!

People Also Ask

What is The Lifespan of Gophers?

Mostly gophers have life span of 5-7 years. Their life span is determined by their predator ratio and environmental factors. In some species of gophers, males' life span is smaller than females with 3-5 years.

What Are The Different Ways to Trap Gophers?

Trapping is the best method to eliminate gophers, many types of trapping involves:

  • Cinch trap (wire trap)
  • Box trap
  • Predator trap
  • Cage trap

What Are the Signs of Presence of Gophers?

Common signs of presence of gophers at your property include presence of land mounds at your property, damaged plant roots, shoots or leaves, damaged underground wires, cables or water supply.

item.title: What Do Termites Look Like? Appearance, Size and Color
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Termites are ancient small creatures which evolved from wood-eating cockroaches around 100 to 150 million years ago. They mainly do attacks on wood. By eating wood, they cause loss of $6.8 billion dollars annually. 

Today's topic is about the appearance of termites. You will also read about their types and colonies in which they are divided. We hope that you will find the answer to your question in this article. Let's start.

What Do Termites Look Like?

Termites are soft-bodied insects of small size about less than one inch long. They have straight antennae and thick waists which help to identify them. Some types of termites like reproductive termites have equal length wings.

Termites are also known as silent destroyers. They mostly attack on wood. They are recognized by a professional person. You do not find them in your house easily because they are hidden in wood or other items. 

Appearance 

Termites have body shapes like flying ants. They have broad and oval shaped bodies with little construction at the waists. They lived in colonies. You do not see them easily but you can find them by the damage that they do.

Size 

They are small in size, almost 3 mm to 1 inch long. Their size depends on the species. Termites have long bodies but conehead termites have pear-shaped heads. Their eggs are also tiny and require magnifying glass to see.

Color 

Termites have different colours such as pale cream, white and dark brown. Most termites are found in cream colour which makes it difficult to identify them. Their colours are different on the basis of their categories.

Types of Termites

There are almost 2000 species of termites in the world. They are the main cause of structure damage. They are divided into different categories. But the major types of termites are following:

Subterranean Termites

Subterranean termites are typically ⅛ inch long in size. They are present in creamy white or dark brown in colour. They like to live in colonies. They use mud tubes for fetching their food without coming outside on the ground. They have the ability to destroy a building in the short term.

Drywood Termites

These pests are almost ⅜ inch to 1 inch long with a white to light brown colour. Drywood termites are generally found in houses and live in wood. They cause serious structural damage in your house. They also live in colonies and grow slowly. Their detection takes a long time, about one month or a year sometimes.

Dampwood termites

Dampwood termites are found in moist areas and they grow rapidly at those places. They can identify by the size which is about ½ inch to ⅝ inch with white to brownish colour. They are attracted to wet places. If you have any such place which has some moisture then dry it. So that your house is protected from termites.

Formosan Termites

The formosan termites are also known as super termites because they cause destruction at large scale. A mature colony of formosan termites can eat 13 grams of wood in a day. They are similar to the subterranean termites as both live underground and in colonies. They are generally ½ inch with creamy white colour.

Desert Termites

Desert termites are light brown in colour with swarmers measuring about ½ to ⅝ inches in length. They are active on the ground. They feed on dry cow manure, dead plants and grass. They generally do not harm the wood or building. Desert termites swarm at sunset. They also come after summer rains.

Characteristics of Termite Castes

Termites are found in colonies. A colony of termites also has different colonies further. So the caste system of termites is more complex. They have division of labour among them. They are also different from one another on the basis of their appearance and work.

Worker Termites

Worker termites are wingless little insects in termite castes. They have soft bodies with round heads and light colour. Normally you find them like white ants. Their body is relatively segmented.They are responsible for collecting food. They also have the responsibility of taking care of the queen and eggs.

Soldier Termites

Like worker termites, they also have soft bodies and large brown heads. They are little larger than worker termites. Soldier termites have robust appearance with dark brown colour. Due to their size and appearance, they are in the defence system. They work to protect colonies from outer threats.

Neotenic Termites

Neotenic termites are secondary species after king or queen. They have the capability of reproduction. So they increase the population of termites. Some types of these termites also have wings. They are looking like the worker termites in colour but large in size from them.

Swarmers 

These termites are known as flying termites. They have long and equal pairs of wings on their body. So their duty is to find a safe place for the next colony. They have larger and harder bodies than soldiers. They close their wings on their abdomen when they are not flying.

Alates 

Alates are the largest members in the colony. They are called king or queen. The queen has an extended abdomen for laying eggs. Its size is also larger than others. The king has the same body pattern like swarmers but it does not have wings. It usually remains in the colony and helps in mating throughout his life.

Termites Resemblance With Other Species

You may be confused about termites because some termites have the same physical look as other pests. It becomes difficult for you to identify them. A professional pest control guy can recognize them easily. Some pests and their characteristics which look like termites are following:

  • Flying ants look the same to termites at some distance. But there is a clear difference between them. Flying ants have narrow waists and bent antennae. Their front wings are also bigger than their back wings. 
  • Carpenter bees do not look like termites but their work is the same. So, you may be puzzled about them. The main difference is that carpenter bees do not eat wood. They also make larger tunnels than termites because they are bigger in size.

Frequently Asked Questions

What do termites look like on wood?

Termites on wood look like a small and soft-bodied insect. They are usually found inside the tunnels which they form in wood. These tunnels make the wood weak and hollow.

What do termites holes look like?

Termites holes are often called kick-out holes. They are tiny small openings about ⅛ inch or less. These holes are mostly present in wood, drywall and furniture.

Do termites get in beds?

Termites rarely affect beds directly. They infest beds in those conditions when the bed frame is placed at the infected area. Termites do not bite humans but they may damage your mattresses, sheets and furniture.

To Summarize

Termites are small pests but they bring serious destruction. They may severely damage your house in a short time. If you are facing this problem then you should take immediate action against them. Otherwise they will become a severe situation which will be difficult to control.

If termites are present in your house and you want to get rid of them. Then we suggest you take the help of a trained pest control company which will handle your problem with their expert workers. Our team will eliminate termites from your house efficiently.

Are Tenants Responsible For Pest Control

item.title: How To Get Rid of Ants? Top 12 Methods Explained & FAQs
item.dc:creator: mikkel
item.content:encoded:
Ants are ancient small insects which are harmful for all things. Their presence at any place is not considered a good thing. So eliminating them from the infected area is important.

In this article, you will read about methods of repelling ants from your house. You will also come to know about the tips which keep them away from your house. Let's start today's guide.

How To Get Rid of Ants?

If you are facing the ants problem and want to eliminate them from your home. Then you should identify them first. You have come to know about the reason which brings them to your house. After knowing their entry points, you have to stop their entrance in your house.

12 Common Methods to Eliminate Ants

We give you some common methods for eliminating ants from your house. There are few household products which help you in eradicating ants. We are sure that after using these purposes, you get rid of ants permanently.

  1. Baking Soda and Sugar

First of all, you should use a mixture of baking soda and sugar powder for killing ants. You have to place this mixture at the infected areas. Sugar attracts ants but baking soda kills them.

  1. Using Borax

Borex is useful against ants. For using it, you should wear gloves. Then prepare a mixture of borax with sugar and warm water. After preparing it, you have to place cotton balls of this mixture at your home where ants are present. 

  1. Citrus Fruites

Citrus fruits like lemon juice prevent ants from coming home. You should mix lemon juice with water and then spray it on windows and doors. This helps you in preventing ants away from your house. 

  1. White Vinegar

It is very cheap and easily available from any grocery store. You have to mix it in water and clean all the places where ants pass. If you see ants, then also spray vinegar on them.

  1. Peppermint Oil

Peppermint is mostly present in the house. You can use it to repel ants from your house. You have to spray peppermint oil and water on windows and other places. You should use it carefully because it is harmful for pets, especially cats.

  1. Neem Oil

Neem is a natural product which can help you in repelling ants. You can easily purchase it from stores or online. It will keep ants away from your house. It is also useful in controlling ant infestation.

  1. Cinnamon

Cinnamon oil is essential in killing ants. For eliminating ants from your house, you should place cotton balls of cinnamon oil on infected areas. You have to check these balls and replace them with fresh ones regularly. 

  1. Chalk 

It is also a useful product which is helpful in controlling the ants infestation. You can use it in your home for eradicating ants. Chalk is very effective in killing ants and preventing your house from them.

  1. Cream of Wheat

Wheat is a common thing which is present in almost all houses. You can use it to repel ants from your home. When ants eat cream of wheat then it expands in their stomach. This causes ants to die and you get rid of them.

  1. Coffee Grounds

You can also use coffee grounds for eliminating ants. You have to put them on those places where ants are found in colonies. You also have to put them in windowsills. You should check and replace grounds regularly.

  1. Black or Red Pepper

Black or red pepper which is commonly found in houses is natural repellent against ants. Their smell irritates the ants and becomes the cause of their death. You can also use them to repel ants from your house.

  1. Liquid Detergents

You should use liquid detergent or glass cleaner for removing the scent of ants pheromones. Ants leave scent pheromones behind them which act as a map of food sources. So use a cleaner or detergent for cleaning their scent.

Tips To Stop Ants From Coming Back

Eliminating ants is very necessary for a houseowner. If you overcome your ants problem then you should also adopt some tips. These habits will help you in preventing ants from coming back to your house. As a result, your house will remain safe from them permanently.

Close Entry Points

Firstly, you should seal all the entry points which are present in your house for ants. You can close them with caulk. You have to seal all gaps and cracks of walls, windows and doors.

Keep Cleanliness

Cleanliness is very essential for removing ants from the house. You should keep your house clean. You have to clean your kitchen from food crumbs and particles. Do not place anything on shelves openly.

Empty Your Bins Regularly

You should empty your garbage bins properly. Do not collect garbage in your house. You have to clean all the bins of your house regularly. This thing also keeps ants away from your house.

Store Pets Food Carefully

If you have pets in your house then take care of their cleanliness. You should keep their food carefully. Take care of their food so that they do not spread food particles. These particles attract ants.

Clean Plant Litter

You should also clean your plant litter properly. You have to maintain your outdoor landscapes. If you do not keep your garden clean then it will become the source of ants infestation.

When should you call a professional exterminator?

If you apply all the strategies of controlling ants but they are not controlled by you. Then you should hire a professional pest control exterminator. They will do this work efficiently. They will secure your house from ants permanently.

Final thoughts

Getting rid of ants is a major problem which you can do by yourself. There are many methods of repelling ants from your house. The products used for this purpose are also household. You can easily use them for eliminating ants.

If the situation is not handled by you, then you can call a professional exterminator which will solve your problem. We make sure your house is safe from ants now. Talk to us now if you need our services in Tulsa and nearby places.

FAQs

What foods attract ants the most?

Ants are mostly attracted to sugar substances, fatty foods and protein rich sources. Major attractants are jelly, fruits, syrup, pets food, candy and fats. They are attracted to these things for getting energy and protein.

Why am I getting ants in the winter?

Ants in winter are usually found in the colony. They already present in your hated home places like walls, under floor and near warm appliances. They may also wake up from dormancy during warmer spells. 

Do ants go away on their own?

Ants do not go away on their own if they have found reliable food, water and shelter sources. When food sources are removed from those places where they are present. Then they often return to forage.
